name: First-launch welcome flow
description: On first app launch, a multi-page wizard walks the user through profile, networks, capabilities, permissions, and optionally default-player pages before opening the main screen.

name: Language selection on welcome
description: The first welcome page shows a language button with the current language that opens a searchable picker over the full language list; the choice switches the app locale immediately and persists.

name: Color theme selection on welcome
description: The first welcome page shows an Auto/Light/Dark theme picker that applies the chosen theme immediately and persists it.

name: Device profile auto-detection and selection
description: A profile page auto-detects the most suitable device profile (phone, tablet, TV, car, VR) with a confidence badge and pre-selects it; the user can override.

name: Device profile preset application
description: Advancing past the profile page applies the selected profile settings preset, configuring default content types, layouts, and behavior for the device.

name: Remote source group toggles on welcome
description: A networks page offers SMB, FTP/SFTP, and Cloud toggle rows that mass-enable or disable the corresponding source flags; rows absent on unsupported flavors.

name: Capability toggles on welcome
description: A functionality page shows per-capability toggle rows (File Manager, Audio, Video, Documents) persisting changes immediately; rows absent when the flavor lacks the capability.

name: Inline OCR engine download on welcome
description: Enabling the OCR toggle on the functionality page enqueues the OCR engines download with inline progress; the capability activates only after a successful install.

name: Inline translation engine download on welcome
description: Enabling the translation toggle on the functionality page enqueues the translation download with inline progress; translation enables only after a successful install.

name: Open Extensions Manager from welcome
description: A button on the functionality page opens the extensions manager overlay to browse and manage optional downloadable modules without leaving the wizard.

name: Adaptive permission list and individual grant
description: A permissions page renders every permission the build can request, grouped by category, with per-row status; tapping a row requests it or opens the relevant system screen.

name: Grant all permissions at once
description: A Grant all button runs a stepwise flow: one batch dialog for regular permissions, then each special permission opened in its own system screen one at a time.

name: Open app system settings from permissions page
description: An Open settings button launches the OS application details screen so users can manually adjust permissions that cannot be requested in-app.

name: Set as default player per media type
description: A default-player page presents per-type buttons (audio, video, images, documents) that trigger the system role chooser; buttons gated by flavor capabilities.

name: One-tap Enable All
description: Enable all now asks the user to confirm the device profile before it applies anything, instead of silently forcing the universal profile; the button is filled so it is readable on the brand backdrop.

name: Auto-open Settings on first run
description: Immediately after completing the welcome flow the first time, the app opens Settings with the main screen as the back-stack root, once only.

name: Welcome re-entry from Settings
description: Users can re-open the welcome wizard from Settings to change device profile or source toggles; a confirmation warns before overwriting tuned settings.

name: Welcome wizard page indicator and navigation
description: An animated page indicator shows progress; Previous and Next buttons navigate pages and Finish appears on the last page.

name: D-pad and keyboard navigation in welcome
description: All welcome pages support D-pad, keyboard, and mouse-wheel navigation with arrow keys, Tab focus cycling, and Enter activation.

name: Enable usage statistics collection
description: An opt-in toggle in General Settings enables local statistics recording; turning it off wipes detailed activity while preserving baseline launch count and first-launch date.

name: Statistics dashboard window
description: When collection is enabled, a Statistics row in General Settings opens a dashboard with summary cards, a media-type distribution bar, and collapsible sections.

name: Summary cards
description: Three summary cards display all-time totals for files sorted, bytes freed by deletions, and combined video plus audio time in the player.

name: Media-type distribution bar
description: A proportional bar chart breaks down processed files by media type (image, video, audio, document, other), shown only when there is activity.

name: Collapsible metric sections
description: The dashboard groups metrics into collapsible sections (Operations, Capture, Viewing, Editing, Sources, Usage); zero-value rows are hidden automatically.

name: Operations metrics
description: Tracks files copied, moved, deleted with bytes, archived, extracted, folders created, duplicate scans run, and duplicates removed.

name: Capture metrics
description: Shows counts of photos taken, videos recorded, voice notes captured, and edge-gesture screenshots taken.

name: Viewing metrics
description: Tracks images viewed, videos watched with watch time, audio played with listen time, documents opened with page count, and frames exported.

name: Editing metrics
description: Tracks the count of drawing/annotation canvases created and text notes written in the in-app editor.

name: Sources connected metric
description: Shows how many network or cloud sources the user has connected; hidden on flavors without cloud or local-network support.

name: Always-on baseline metrics
description: Shows launch count, first-launch date, and install version regardless of the opt-in toggle; session count and active time appear when collection is on.

name: Send statistics report to author
description: A Send to author button builds a text report off the UI thread and opens the email chooser pre-filled with the author address and the report attached.

name: Export statistics report as text file
description: An Export button builds the same text report and opens a system share chooser so the user can save or forward the file.

name: Local folder source
description: Adds local device folders as browsable media sources, with optional subdirectory scanning, hidden-file visibility, and media-type filter per source.

name: SMB/NAS network source
description: Connects to SMB shares on the local network as browsable media sources with pooled connections and background lifecycle management.

name: FTP network source
description: Connects to FTP servers as browsable and playable media sources with connection pooling and file-operation handlers.

name: SFTP network source
description: Connects to SFTP servers as browsable media sources with SSH connection pooling, passphrase support, and file-operation handlers.

name: Cloud drive source
description: Connects Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive as media sources with per-provider OAuth, folder picker UI, and remote editing support.

name: Virtual predefined resources
description: Provisions built-in virtual sources (All Files, Camera) on first launch; idempotent provisioning repairs partial installs on subsequent starts.

name: Resource export to share file
description: Exports configured resources including credentials to a portable file that can be opened, shared, or imported via Backup and Restore on another device.

name: Resource import from share file
description: Parses a resource-share file and adds the contained sources to the local database, merging credentials and settings.

name: Network file-list index cache
description: Persists compressed file-list snapshots for SMB/FTP/SFTP sources so subsequent directory opens bypass slow network fetches.

name: Streaming playback cache
description: Caches byte ranges of remote media files locally to enable smooth network/cloud playback and session resume after reconnect.

name: Thumbnail cache for remote sources
description: Stores generated thumbnails for network and cloud files in a cache to avoid repeated remote fetches.

name: Per-resource PIN protection
description: Optionally locks a source behind a numeric PIN stored in the resource record; the PIN is included when the resource is exported.

name: Toggle remote sources on/off
description: Per-protocol switches hide or reveal their resources and stop background activity when disabled, without deleting the source records.

name: Unified settings backup including sources
description: Serializes all resources, credentials, favorites, schedules, and web-auth sessions into a single backup restorable after reinstall to file or Google Drive.

name: NAS/host auto-discovery
description: Scans the active IPv4 subnet via concurrent TCP port probes for SMB, FTP, and SFTP and streams discovered hosts to the add-resource UI.

name: SMB share enumeration
description: After a host is discovered or entered, lists available SMB shares on that host so the user can pick one as the resource root.

name: Network speed test with thread recommendation
description: Measures read and write throughput to a resource and returns recommended thread count and buffer size to optimize multi-threaded transfers.

name: Resource connection test
description: Tests reachability and authentication of a configured source and returns status, latency in milliseconds, and a diagnostic message.

name: SFTP SSH private-key authentication
description: Authenticates SFTP resources using an SSH private key file with optional passphrase instead of a password.

name: SFTP host-key fingerprint pinning
description: Stores a SHA-256 host-key fingerprint per SFTP resource and aborts connections where the server presents a non-matching key.

name: Google Drive OAuth authentication
description: Authenticates Google Drive via OAuth 2.0 with token refresh and a state machine tracking signed-in, expired, and error states.

name: Dropbox OAuth authentication
description: Authenticates Dropbox via the SDK OAuth flow with a folder picker and managed token lifecycle.

name: OneDrive OAuth authentication
description: Authenticates Microsoft OneDrive via MSAL with a dedicated coordinator, REST client, and folder picker.

name: Cloud settings backup to Google Drive
description: Uploads the full settings backup payload to the user Google Drive account, enabling restore on any device with the same account.

name: Scheduled background network sync
description: Runs periodic background jobs that refresh cached file lists for enabled network sources and update file counts and last-sync timestamps.

name: SFTP key auth for predefined XML resources
description: Bundled XML config resources support SSH key authentication so pre-configured deployments can use key-based SFTP without credential entry.

name: File manager mode
description: Toggles a resource-level flag to list every file type in the folder, overriding the media-type filter configured for the resource.

name: Show hidden files toggle
description: When file-manager mode is enabled, a secondary toggle reveals dot-prefixed files and folders that are normally invisible.

name: ZIP archive extraction with password
description: Opens a ZIP file to extract its contents in place; protected ZIPs prompt for a password and unsupported protection produces a clear error.

name: Office and PDF document handoff
description: Filters and opens DOC, DOCX, RTF, ODT, or protected PDF files by handing them to an external viewer, with a password indicator in the row.

name: Binary file bottom-sheet menu
description: Tapping a non-archive binary file shows a bottom-sheet with Share, Open in, Copy, Move, Rename, and Delete actions.

name: Subfolder navigation with path stack
description: When subdirectory scanning is enabled, folders appear as tappable items and the browse screen maintains a back-navigable path stack with per-directory cache.

name: Sort modes
description: The browse list supports many sort modes (name, date, size, type, artist, title, duration, date taken, random, manual) persisted per resource.

name: Random shuffle with re-shuffle
description: Random sort shuffles the file list with a mixed seed; tapping shuffle again immediately reshuffles without re-scanning, always a different order.

name: Drag-to-reorder in manual sort
description: In manual sort mode, items can be long-pressed and dragged to reorder; the new order is persisted per resource and directory.

name: List/grid display mode toggle
description: Switches the browse screen between a detail list and a thumbnail grid; audio-only resources are locked to list mode; persisted per resource.

name: Session file filter
description: Applies a temporary filter by filename, date range, size range, and media type, in-memory from cache when available, not persisted after the session.

name: Thumbnail loading
description: Loads thumbnails via source-specific loaders (local, SMB, cloud, PDF); paused during fast scroll and auto-disabled for very large folders.

name: Background thumbnail preload worker
description: After a network resource sync, a background task preloads thumbnails for cached entries over Wi-Fi, skipping files already cached.

name: File info row
description: Each browse row shows a contextual detail line: resolution and date taken for images, resolution and duration for video, artist-title for audio, size and date otherwise.

name: Multi-file selection with range select
description: Long-press enters selection mode; long-press a checkbox extends to a contiguous range; select-all and clear-all are available in the action bar.

name: Favorite toggle per file
description: Each browse row exposes a star button to mark or unmark the file as a favorite, reflected immediately via a partial list update.

name: Inline audio playback in browse list
description: Tapping play on an audio row plays it directly in the list without opening the full player; SMB audio downloads to cache with next-track prefetch.

name: Pagination for large folders
description: Folders with hundreds of files switch to a paging data source loading files in chunks to prevent memory pressure.

name: Live file-system observer for local resources
description: An OS-level file observer watches the local directory and debounces change events to apply in-memory renames or trigger a reload.

name: MediaStore change observer
description: A content observer on the MediaStore URI detects external changes such as camera saves to the current local folder and triggers a refresh.

name: Persisted file list cache
description: When enabled for a resource, the scanned file list is stored so subsequent opens restore the list instantly without re-scanning.

name: Read-only resource mode
description: A resource marked read-only prevents all write operations from the browse screen; write buttons are hidden and attempts show an error.

name: Resource access PIN protection
description: A resource with an access PIN requires the user to enter it before the browse screen opens, shown as a lock indicator on the resource row.

name: Scroll navigation buttons
description: Floating buttons appear contextually on long lists to jump to top or bottom or scroll one page at a time; hidden when all items fit.

name: Create new folder inside resource
description: A toolbar action creates a subdirectory inside the current path across local, SMB, SFTP, FTP, and cloud; hidden for read-only resources.

name: Small controls and compact elements modes
description: Settings apply a reduced-size layout to browse items and toolbar, useful on low-resolution or small screens.

name: Cross-protocol file copy
description: Copies files between any combination of Local, SMB, FTP, SFTP, and Cloud endpoints with byte-level progress and speed/ETA reporting.

name: Cross-protocol file move
description: Moves files between any combination of Local, SMB, FTP, SFTP, and Cloud endpoints with byte-level progress reporting.

name: Local copy and move (photos flavor)
description: Copies or moves image files between Local, SMB, FTP, SFTP, and Cloud endpoints from the Photos-only flavor.

name: Local-only file copy and move (lite flavor)
description: Copies or moves files between local storage paths only; network and cloud endpoints are not available in this flavor.

name: File rename
description: Renames a single file or folder on local, SMB, FTP, SFTP, or cloud, triggering a MediaStore rescan after completion.

name: Soft delete to trash
description: Moves deleted files to a per-directory trash snapshot folder instead of permanently removing them, enabling later restore.

name: Permanent delete
description: Permanently removes selected files or directories across local, SMB, FTP, SFTP, and cloud; requests MediaStore batch-delete consent on Android 11+.

name: Undo last delete
description: Restores files from the nearest trash snapshot in the current directory, reversing the most recent soft-delete.

name: Automatic trash cleanup
description: A background worker periodically removes expired trash snapshot directories from all local resources to reclaim storage.

name: Duplicate file finder
description: Scans selected resources using a three-phase engine (size, quick-hash, full SHA-256) to identify identical files with auto-delete or manual review.

name: Delete files by size threshold
description: Scans a resource for files below a maximum or above a minimum size, previews the match list, then deletes confirmed files.

name: Photo capture to any destination
description: Launches the system or in-app camera to take a photo saved directly to the currently browsed local, network, or cloud folder.

name: Video capture to any destination
description: Launches the system camera to record a video saved directly to the currently browsed local, network, or cloud folder.

name: Voice memo recording to any destination
description: Records a microphone audio note and saves it to a local or network/cloud folder with audio-focus management.

name: ZIP archive creation
description: Compresses a selection of local files into a named ZIP archive with per-file progress; network/cloud source paths are skipped with a warning.

name: Scheduled file operations
description: Configures recurring or one-shot copy, move, or delete tasks executed in the background on a user-defined schedule.

name: Background transfer progress with speed and ETA
description: Copy and move operations emit per-file byte counts, transfer speed, and cumulative progress shown in a progress dialog.

name: Browse copy and move background mode
description: Browse copy and move operations can be sent to the background, keep running with a progress notification, and reattach to the same Browse context when reopened.

name: File name conflict auto-resolution
description: Automatically appends a suffix to destination file names when a collision is detected, avoiding silent overwrites without user input.

name: Operation undo in browse and player
description: Tracks the last copy, move, or delete batch as undoable, allowing single-tap reversal from both the browser and the player.

name: Cloud re-authentication recovery
description: When a cloud operation fails on an expired token, the result carries a re-authentication signal that prompts sign-in without losing the queued operation.

name: Quick Sort destination panel in player
description: The player shows Copy and Move panels with color-coded shortcut buttons for every destination resource, sorting the current file in one tap.

name: Configurable destination slot limit
description: The maximum number of destination shortcut buttons shown can be set in Settings; default is 10 and options extend to 30, with adaptive layout.

name: Mark resource as destination
description: Any non-read-only, non-virtual resource can be flagged as a destination, assigning it the next slot order and a distinct preset color.

name: Auto-advance to next file after sort
description: An optional setting automatically advances to the next file in the player immediately after a copy or move completes.

name: Undo last sort operation
description: After a copy or move to a destination, an undo action reverses the operation; the undo capability can be disabled in settings.

name: Custom path picker in sort panel
description: A button in each sort panel opens a folder picker so the user can copy or move to any path not pre-configured as a destination.

name: Downloads provisioned as first destination
description: On a fresh install the public Downloads folder is automatically added as the first destination so the sort panels work without setup.

name: Collapsible Copy and Move panels
description: Each of the Copy and Move panels can be collapsed; when both are collapsed they share one horizontal row to save screen space.

name: Width-adaptive destination button layout
description: Destination buttons are distributed across rows and their font size scales from the button width, using one row on wide screens.

name: Per-destination color coding
description: Each destination button is rendered in a unique preset color assigned when marked; text color auto-switches to black or white by luminance.

name: Overwrite control for copy and move
description: Independent settings control whether existing files are silently overwritten during copy and during move operations; both default to off.

name: In-place image rotation
description: Destructively rotates the source image file in 90-degree steps on local or network storage, preserving and resetting EXIF orientation.

name: In-place image flip
description: Destructively flips the source image horizontally or vertically on local or network storage, preserving EXIF metadata.

name: Interactive crop with region selection
description: Displays a draggable overlay and crops the selected region using a region decoder with EXIF-corrected coordinate mapping.

name: Crop to new file
description: Saves the selected crop region as a separate file with a crop suffix, without overwriting the original.

name: Compressed copy
description: Saves a JPEG-compressed copy of the current image to a user-chosen destination without touching the original.

name: Brightness adjustment
description: Applies a brightness offset to the image in-place using a color matrix and saves the result as JPEG.

name: Contrast adjustment
description: Scales pixel values to raise or lower image contrast using a color matrix transform saved to the source file.

name: Saturation adjustment
description: Adjusts color saturation from grayscale to vivid using a color matrix transform saved to the source file.

name: Grayscale color filter
description: Applies a grayscale color matrix filter to the image and overwrites the source file with the result.

name: Sepia color filter
description: Applies a sepia-tone color matrix filter to the image and overwrites the source file.

name: Negative color filter
description: Inverts all color channels via a color matrix filter and overwrites the source image file.

name: Network image editing
description: Downloads a network image to a temp file, applies rotate/flip/filter/adjustment operations, then uploads the result back to the original path.

name: Animated GIF/WEBP/APNG playback with pause
description: Plays animated GIF, WEBP, and APNG files with a lifecycle-aware play/pause toggle and per-file state tracking.

name: GIF playback speed control
description: Adjusts GIF animation speed from 0.25x to 4.0x by rebuilding frame delays and overwriting the source file.

name: GIF first-frame export
description: Extracts and saves the first frame of a GIF as a PNG to Downloads with a first-frame suffix.

name: Animated image frame extraction
description: Extracts all frames from GIF, WEBP, or APNG files to individual PNG files in the source or a chosen folder.

name: Freehand brush drawing on image
description: Overlays a transparent canvas on an image and records freehand strokes with configurable color, size, and opacity.

name: Rectangle shape tool
description: Draws outlined rectangles on the canvas overlay with live drag preview using the active color and brush size.

name: Oval shape tool
description: Draws outlined ovals and circles on the canvas overlay with live drag preview using the active color and brush size.

name: Text annotation layer
description: Places a text string at a tapped position on the canvas with configurable size and color.

name: Eraser tool
description: Clears canvas pixels using a clear blend mode at twice the current brush size, encoded as a transparent stroke.

name: Persistent color and brush preferences
description: Stores last color, custom swatch, brush size, text size, and opacity in preferences that survive sessions.

name: In-place save of annotated image
description: Merges the draw overlay onto the base image and writes the composite back to the file path, with staging for network/cloud resources.

name: Blank canvas creation
description: Creates a new blank image file in the current folder or staging area and opens it in draw mode for a new annotation session.

name: Send annotated drawing via Send to menu
description: Composites the overlay with the base image into a cached file and passes it to the unified Send To menu for gated-receiver dispatch.

name: Unified Send to bottom sheet
description: Presents all enabled, available, and type-matching receivers in a single bottom sheet in fixed order; auto-dispatches when only one qualifies.

name: System Share receiver
description: Opens the Android system share chooser for any file type with multi-file selection; always enabled and available.

name: Email receiver
description: Attaches one or more files to a new email; enabled by default when internet access is available.

name: Telegram receiver
description: Shares files to any installed Telegram variant with multi-file batch support, resolving the app label dynamically.

name: WhatsApp receiver
description: Shares files to WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business; shown only when either package is installed.

name: Instagram receiver
description: Shares a single image, video, or GIF to Instagram; on a multi-selection it applies to the first file with a hint.

name: Google Keep receiver
description: Exports the current image to Google Keep as an attachment; restricted to images and requires Keep installed.

name: Google Lens receiver
description: Opens the current image or GIF in Google Lens for visual search; requires Google services and is off by default.

name: Print receiver
description: Sends images, GIFs, PDFs, text, and office documents to the Android print subsystem; always available and enabled.

name: Open in another app receiver
description: Opens the current file in a third-party app for any file type; always enabled and available.

name: Per-receiver settings toggle with availability gating
description: Each Send to receiver has a settings toggle with help tooltip; unavailable receivers are hidden from the menu at runtime.

name: Send to overflow submenu in player command bar
description: Builds a hierarchical submenu in the player overflow bar using the same receiver list and gating, with per-receiver app icons.

name: Session save and restore
description: Saves the exact playback position periodically and restores it automatically on the next open, showing a resume toast with the timestamp.

name: Remote session restore on cold start
description: On app cold start, restores the last active network or cloud video session including its saved playback position.

name: Video frame capture to destination
description: Captures the current video frame as PNG or JPG and saves it to a configured resource with a Downloads fallback.

name: Frame filename with timecode
description: Saved frame filenames encode the source video name and the exact playback position in an HHhMMmSSs format.

name: Picture-in-Picture mode
description: Enters a floating video window on home-button press or a dedicated button with remote play/pause; supported on Android 12+ only.

name: D-pad and TV remote focus navigation
description: Full D-pad and remote focus navigation is supported in the video player for Android TV boxes and head units.

name: Blu-ray Transport Stream (.m2ts) playback
description: Auto-detects 192-byte BD packets and strips the header; plain 188-byte MPEG-TS files with a .m2ts extension play without unnecessary stripping.

name: Unsupported audio track notice
description: When all audio tracks in a file are unsupported by the device, a one-time toast lists the detected codecs instead of failing silently.

name: Playback speed control
description: Adjusts playback speed in preset steps; the last-used speed is persisted and restored on the next video.

name: Subtitle track selection and styling
description: Enables or disables subtitles, selects subtitle language preference, and applies custom font size and family to the subtitle view.

name: Audio track selection
description: Lists available audio tracks with language, codec, and channels; marks unsupported tracks and allows manual selection.

name: Preferred audio language auto-selection
description: Automatically selects the audio track matching the user-configured preferred language via track selection parameters.

name: Loop single video
description: Toggles repeat-one mode to loop the current video file indefinitely from the player settings dialog.

name: Swipe gesture navigation
description: In fullscreen a multi-zone touch grid handles next/previous/back/sort; in command-panel mode a three-zone layout handles next and previous.

name: Pinch-to-zoom on video
description: A scale gesture detector feeds scale factor into the player to allow pinch-zoom on the video surface.

name: Screen rotation lock and follow-OS mode
description: A two-level rotation hierarchy: a program-wide follow-OS toggle and, when off, a player-only sensor or locked toggle; hidden without an accelerometer.

name: Keep screen on during playback
description: A dependent setting keeps the screen awake only while the player or standalone players are active; shown only when the global option is off.

name: 3D stereo mode selection
description: Lets the user set the stereoscopic display mode (Auto, SBS, OU, Mono) in the player settings dialog.

name: Auto stereo detection
description: Analyses video track metadata and spatial tags off the main thread to identify SBS, OU, and 360 content automatically.

name: Hue and brightness color adjustment
description: Real-time hue rotation and brightness offset via a debounced video-effects pipeline, persisted and restored on the next session.

name: Network video buffering with adaptive load control
description: Per-protocol buffer windows tuned to balance startup latency and memory for SMB, SFTP, FTP, and cloud playback.

name: Playback health check and stuck recovery
description: A delayed check compares player position after buffering; if unchanged across checks the player is treated as stuck and recovery is triggered.

name: MediaPlayer fallback for unsupported formats
description: When the primary engine cannot handle a file, playback retries with the platform MediaPlayer, routing pause/play/seek to the active engine.

name: Remote source availability gate
description: Before playback the player checks whether the target protocol source is enabled and returns a localized error instead of attempting a connection when disabled.

name: OpenXR immersive session engine
description: A dedicated activity hosts a native OpenXR session with a render thread driving the frame loop on arm64 headsets including Quest 3 and Android XR.

name: 360-degree equirectangular image viewer
description: Renders full-sphere equirectangular images as an OpenXR composition layer; monoscopic and stereoscopic variants auto-detected from filename markers.

name: 180-degree hemisphere image viewer
description: Renders front-hemisphere and VR180 fisheye images in immersive mode with per-eye UV crop for stereoscopic layouts.

name: Virtual cinema screen for flat files
description: Flat images and videos are rendered on a virtual flat screen inside the immersive environment, configurable as Cinema, Full SBS, or Full OU.

name: Stereoscopic SBS/OU rendering
description: Side-by-Side and Over-Under stereoscopic formats are decoded and presented per-eye, resolved from filename markers, metadata, or aspect-ratio heuristics.

name: Cylinder-projected panorama viewer
description: 180-degree cylinder-projected panoramic content is rendered via an OpenXR cylinder composition layer without spherical pole distortion.

name: Immersive video playback
description: Local videos including stereo 3D and 360 play inside the OpenXR session via a native GL external texture surface with seek-restore from a state snapshot.

name: Dynamic media playlist in immersive mode
description: The immersive session hosts an ordered playlist of images and videos navigable forward and backward without leaving the OpenXR session.

name: Head-locked HUD overlay
description: A head-locked banner displays the current filename, detected projection type, and stereo layout; error states show a red variant.

name: Interactive HUD control panel
description: A world-locked panel with Play/Pause, Prev, Next and Volume and Depth sliders responds to controller ray-cast hover and click.

name: Adjustable stereo parallax depth
description: A real-time HUD slider controls a parallax-shift uniform passed to the shader, tuning perceived stereo depth without leaving the session.

name: Controller haptic feedback
description: Controller vibrations are triggered via OpenXR haptic actions: a short pulse on button click and a lighter pulse on ray-hover.

name: Hand tracking input support
description: The VR manifest requests hand-tracking and the native action set processes hand-tracking input for session exit.

name: Multi-source input exit handler
description: Unifies controller button events, Android key events, and motion events into a single exit-request flow with a grace period after the first frame.

name: Automatic stereo format detection
description: Auto-detects stereo and panoramic formats from filename markers, embedded spatial metadata, and optional aspect-ratio heuristics with configurable confidence.

name: Per-file stereo format override
description: The user can manually override the detected stereo mode per file; the override persists and takes priority over auto-detection on next playback.

name: Auto-immersive entry for stereo content
description: When enabled, opening a stereo or panoramic file from the player automatically launches the immersive session without an extra tap.

name: Player VR launch badge and overflow entry
description: Surfaces a badge overlay and overflow entry in the flat player for stereo-capable files when the XR runtime is available, capturing player state before handoff.

name: Flat-player state snapshot and restore
description: On launching immersion from the player, full player state is serialized and passed to the XR activity, then restored exactly on exit.

name: XR runtime detection
description: Probes system features to distinguish Meta Quest from Android XR from non-XR devices, driving feature visibility without a build flag.

name: 3D/VR master toggle with profile sync
description: A master toggle controls VR feature visibility globally; selecting the VR Headset device profile enables it automatically.

name: VR settings block in media settings
description: A settings block exposes the master toggle, test immersive button, detection switches, default layout and projection, render mode, auto-immersive, and FPS overlay.

name: FPS overlay in immersive HUD
description: When enabled, the immersive HUD shows a live smoothed frame-rate counter sampled from the native frame loop.

name: Background audio service
description: Runs audio-only playback on a persistent media session service that survives activity destruction, with notification drawer controls.

name: Notification playback controls
description: The system notification drawer shows play/pause, seek, and track info backed by the media session while audio plays in the background.

name: Configurable back-exit behavior
description: When background audio is active, Back can ask each time, always stop the service, or always leave it running, per a setting.

name: Chromecast casting
description: Casts the open audio, image, GIF, or video file to a Chromecast device via a local HTTP proxy; network/cloud files download to cache first.

name: Online lyrics search and display
description: Searches for song lyrics using tags and filename, then shows them in a fullscreen overlay with configurable font size.

name: MIDI file playback
description: Plays MID and MIDI files from local, network, and cloud sources with an explicit MIME hint across all resource types.

name: YouTube Music search handoff
description: Opens a YouTube Music search for the current track in one tap, with an audio-only contract preventing video artifacts as results.

name: Online cover art search
description: When no embedded cover is found, searches iTunes, Deezer, and the Cover Art Archive in priority order to fetch high-resolution art.

name: Animated equalizer bars backdrop
description: Displays sine-wave-animated pastel equalizer bars as a full-screen background when no cover art is available.

name: Wave and particle backdrop
description: Renders procedural sine-wave paths and drifting particles with a motion-blur trail as an alternative no-cover-art backdrop.

name: Pulsing rings backdrop
description: Shows concentric pulsing rings with a static music-note icon as a minimal animated backdrop when cover art is absent.

name: Downloadable looping video backdrops
description: Plays one of several looping clips installed on demand as a full-screen animated background when no cover art is available.

name: Background photos during audio playback
description: Loads random static images from a selected resource and cycles through them as a full-screen backdrop while audio plays.

name: Playback order modes
description: Cycles through loop-list, play-once, shuffle, and repeat-one modes via a single command-panel button.

name: Sleep timer
description: Counts down a configurable duration then pauses playback with an optional volume fade-out; remaining time shown as a badge.

name: Vinyl record playback indicator
description: Displays a small rotating vinyl-record animation in the player corner while audio is playing; stops on pause.

name: Audio focus management
description: Requests and releases audio focus on start/stop and pauses on transient or permanent focus loss with an API-level fork.

name: Quick Settings tile play/pause
description: A system Quick Settings tile toggles audio play/pause or launches music playback when nothing is playing.

name: Image and GIF rotation with custom interval
description: Auto-advances through images and GIFs at a per-resource interval (default 10 s, range 1 s to 1 h).

name: Countdown display before slide advance
description: Shows a 3-2-1 countdown overlay before each slide transition so the user can anticipate the advance.

name: Background music from resource
description: Plays audio files from a separately selected resource as background music during an image/GIF slideshow, with track display and shuffle.

name: Play-to-end mode for audio and video
description: When enabled, audio and video files in a mixed slideshow play to completion before the timer advances, suppressing the countdown.

name: Keep screen awake during slideshow
description: Forces the screen on for the duration of an active slideshow and restores the global keep-screen-on policy when stopped.

name: Network-loss auto-stop
description: Monitors connectivity and stops the slideshow with a descriptive message when the connection to a remote resource is lost.

name: Repeated-failure auto-stop
description: Counts consecutive load or playback failures and stops the slideshow after a threshold streak, distinguishing unavailable-resource errors.

name: Audio slideshow photo mode
description: During audio-only playback with slideshow active, hides the audio UI and shows a full-screen photo that advances each tick.

name: EPUB DRM-free viewing
description: Renders DRM-free EPUB files in a WebView, serving embedded images and fonts from the archive.

name: EPUB font size adjustment
description: Adjusts EPUB body font size via swipe gestures or settings presets.

name: EPUB font family selection
description: Chooses between sans-serif, serif, or monospace font families for EPUB body text via settings.

name: EPUB reader themes
description: Switches the EPUB reading theme among Light, Dark, Sepia, and OLED Black via dynamic CSS injected into the WebView.

name: EPUB line spacing control
description: Configures the EPUB line-height multiplier to improve reading comfort.

name: EPUB horizontal margin control
description: Adjusts EPUB horizontal padding to set how much whitespace appears on each side of the text.

name: EPUB chapter navigation and map
description: Navigates chapters with prev/next or a table-of-contents sheet, restoring the last chapter position on reopen.

name: EPUB in-chapter and cross-chapter search
description: Searches within the current chapter or runs a full cross-chapter text search with a capped result list.

name: EPUB Read Aloud
description: Synthesizes EPUB page text via the system text-to-speech engine with play, pause, and stop controls.

name: EPUB text selection
description: Selects text in the EPUB WebView via a JavaScript bridge that captures selection events and exposes the string to native code.

name: EPUB offline translation overlay
description: Translates selected EPUB chapter text offline and displays the result in a collapsible overlay panel.

name: PDF viewing with page navigation
description: Renders PDF pages at high resolution in a zoomable, pannable view with prev/next buttons and a go-to-page dialog.

name: PDF continuous scroll mode
description: Toggles between single-page mode and a vertical scroll mode with a persisted preference.

name: PDF color modes
description: Cycles the displayed PDF page through Normal, Night, and Sepia color filters in both page and scroll modes.

name: PDF last-page position restore
description: Saves the last viewed PDF page index and restores it automatically when the same file is reopened.

name: PDF thumbnail navigation sheet
description: Opens a bottom-sheet grid of page thumbnails to jump directly to any page in a large document.

name: PDF text selection and copy
description: Activates a text-selection overlay to highlight and copy page text, using native extraction on newer APIs and OCR fallback otherwise.

name: PDF Read Aloud
description: Reads the current PDF page text aloud via the system text-to-speech engine coordinated with the selection manager.

name: PDF hyperlink tap-to-open
description: Detects and opens URL hyperlink annotations on PDF pages using native link APIs on newer versions and a regex fallback otherwise.

name: PDF in-page text search
description: Searches for text across the current PDF page, highlighting matches and navigating between them.

name: PDF offline translation overlay
description: Translates the current PDF page offline and shows the result in a resizable overlay card.

name: PDF export pages as JPG
description: Exports all PDF pages as JPG images to a Downloads exports folder using MediaStore on newer versions.

name: TXT and MD file viewer
description: Opens and displays text and markdown files from local, SMB, SFTP, FTP, or cloud storage with paged loading.

name: Markdown live rendering
description: Toggles markdown rendering for MD files in the viewer, with syntax highlighting applied to plain-text mode.

name: Line numbers display
description: Optionally prepends line numbers to each displayed line, with offsets tracked correctly across pages.

name: Encoding detection and picker
description: Auto-detects file encoding on load and lets the user reopen the file with a different charset via the encoding indicator.

name: Font size adjustment via swipe
description: Adjusts viewer and translation-overlay font sizes by horizontal swipe gestures on the text area.

name: In-place text editing with save
description: Switches a loaded text file into edit mode and saves changes back to local, SMB, SFTP, FTP, or cloud storage, with a save-with-rename dialog.

name: Auto-save drafts
description: While editing, a draft is written periodically when content changes and restored if the editor reopens before an explicit save.

name: Undo/redo history
description: Tracks a bounded stack of edit actions and supports multi-step undo and redo during an editing session.

name: Find and replace
description: Provides a panel for case-insensitive search with match navigation, single-match replace, and replace-all within the editor.

name: Text viewer Read Aloud
description: Reads the currently displayed text page aloud using the system text-to-speech engine with play, pause, and stop controls.

name: Send text to Google Keep
description: Sends the current text content to Google Keep as a note from the viewer or editor; shown only when Keep is installed.

name: Embedded calculator on selected text
description: Launches a calculator in result-return mode from selected text; the computed result is inserted back at the cursor.

name: Offline translation overlay
description: Translates the displayed text content offline and shows the result in a collapsible side panel.

name: Text file standalone viewer
description: Opens text and markdown files directly from external intents in a standalone activity reusing the same read/edit/save feature set.

name: New text note creation
description: Creates a blank text or markdown note destined for a local or remote resource from the browse screen and opens it in edit mode.

name: Offline OCR engine (ML Kit)
description: Extracts text from images using on-device ML Kit text recognition without a network connection.

name: Offline OCR engine (Tesseract)
description: Recognizes text from images using Tesseract with on-demand fast and high-quality language models, with strong Cyrillic support.

name: Offline OCR engine (PaddleOCR)
description: Provided an additional OCR engine based on PaddleOCR native libraries for arm64 in sideload and VR flavors. Withdrawn in S1703: the output-parsing stage was never implemented, so the engine always fell back to Tesseract.

name: Multi-engine OCR fallback routing
description: Automatically selects the best available OCR engine for the chosen language and falls back to the default engine if none returns a result.

name: Image OCR text extraction in player
description: Extracts text from the displayed image or first GIF frame using the available offline OCR engine, shown in an editable viewer.

name: PDF page OCR and translation
description: Recognizes and translates the rendered PDF page bitmap with a choice of simple overlay or spatially-aligned block overlay, cached per page.

name: EPUB chapter translation overlay
description: Translates the visible EPUB chapter text in a resizable overlay with adjustable font size, toggled by a player button.

name: Lens-style image translation overlay
description: Yellow debug frame and crosshair no longer drawn over the Lens translation overlay in release builds (kept behind debug builds)

name: Photo OCR capture flow
description: Launches an in-app camera, presents a crop frame, lets the user pick languages on the crop screen, runs OCR plus offline translation, and shows the result.

name: Camera OCR result save as text
description: Saves the recognized or translated text from the camera OCR flow as a timestamped text file to the configured destination.

name: OCR source and target language picker
description: A searchable language picker lists supported source languages with auto-detect and target languages, ordered by interface language.

name: Translation session settings dialog
description: An in-player dialog configures OCR source language, target language, overlay style, font size, and font family, applied immediately.

name: Offline ML Kit translation
description: Translates recognized text fully offline using on-device translation supporting more than two dozen languages.

name: Translation model pre-warming
description: Background downloads the translation model for the selected target language before the OCR hot path to avoid an inline prompt during capture.

name: Homoglyph Latin-to-Cyrillic OCR correction
description: Post-processes OCR output to replace visually similar Latin characters with Cyrillic equivalents, reducing misrecognition on Cyrillic text.

name: Translation result caching
description: Caches translated text and block results per file path and page index in memory, avoiding redundant OCR and translation within a session.

name: Downloadable Extensions manager screen
description: A settings screen lists every optional module and OCR language pack grouped by section with per-item status, size, and download/remove actions.

name: Bulk Install All / Uninstall All
description: Single-tap buttons concurrently download all not-yet-installed extensions or sequentially uninstall all installed ones.

name: On-demand OCR engines download
description: Downloads the Tesseract native library stack for the device ABI from a pinned mirror with SHA-256 verification, surviving updates and cache clears.

name: On-demand PaddleOCR engine download
description: Downloaded PaddleOCR native libraries for arm64 from a pinned mirror to add an OCR engine for sideload flavors. Withdrawn in S1703 together with the engine it delivered.

name: On-demand OCR language pack (Russian)
description: Downloads the high-quality Russian Tesseract model with SHA-256 validation, enabling superior Cyrillic OCR quality.

name: On-demand OCR language pack (Ukrainian)
description: Downloads the high-quality Ukrainian Tesseract model with SHA-256 validation, enabling accurate Ukrainian-script OCR.

name: On-demand FFmpeg DTS decoder download
description: Downloads the FFmpeg native library for the device ABI with SHA-256 verification, enabling DTS and DTS-HD audio decoding in the video player.

name: On-demand audio background videos download
description: Downloads looping background video clips from a pinned mirror with integrity checks, used as audio-player backdrops when no cover art is present.

name: Download decline handling
description: When the user declines an on-demand download, the feature stays unavailable without affecting other functionality and prompts again next time.

name: Downloaded extension persistence
description: Deliverable payloads are stored outside the system cache and tracked via a persistent marker so they survive app updates and cache clears.

name: Extension download progress tracking
description: Each download emits reactive progress states (queued, running, verifying, installed, failed) shown as a live indicator in the manager row.

name: Flavor-scoped extension visibility
description: The manager displays only rows actionable in the running flavor; flavors without OCR or translation never show those rows.

name: Email crash report from error dialog
description: A button in the error detail dialog emails crash details with the app log to the author when a real exception-backed error is shown.

name: Crash report prompt after restart
description: On the next launch after an unexpected crash, the app offers to email the crash report with the app log to the author.

name: Settings full-text search with spotlight
description: A search overlay matches any toggle or option by keyword and scrolls to and highlights the result in the relevant settings tab.

name: Color theme selection
description: A spinner in General settings selects Auto, Light, or Dark theme; a restart is required to apply the change.

name: System diagnostic info
description: A button gathers a masked system report viewable in a dialog, with a secondary action to reveal the unmasked report after confirmation.

name: TV remote and keyboard key remapping
description: A dedicated screen reassigns any player command to D-pad, gamepad, keyboard, or mouse buttons, with per-group and global reset.

name: D-pad acceleration for grid navigation
description: Holding a D-pad direction past a repeat threshold triggers a page-jump, accelerating navigation in large grids.

name: Wear OS companion settings sync
description: A bottom sheet pushes selected settings to the paired Wear OS companion app with an animation; hidden when the build lacks Wear support.

name: Unified settings backup and restore to local file
description: Exports sources, favorites, schedules, network passwords, and saved web sign-ins to a local file and restores them after reinstall.

name: Settings backup and restore via Google Drive
description: Signs in with a Google account to back up or restore the unified payload to Drive; restore shows backup date, device, and item counts.

name: Set as default media app from settings
description: Buttons register the app as the OS default handler for images, audio, video, and documents; only buttons for present capabilities are shown.

name: Player-only keep screen on
description: A dependent toggle keeps the display awake only while the player or standalone players are open; visible only when the global option is off.

name: Program-wide follow OS auto-rotate
description: A toggle makes every app screen follow the system auto-rotate setting; hidden on devices without an accelerometer.

name: Player-only follow OS auto-rotate
description: A secondary toggle lets only the player follow system auto-rotate when the program-wide toggle is off; hidden without an accelerometer.

name: Big Buttons Mode
description: Enlarges player buttons and stretches controls to full width with an adaptive toolbar count; ideal for car head units.

name: App language selection
description: A spinner selects the app language (system default, English, Russian, Ukrainian) with a restart dialog on change.

name: Compact UI elements mode
description: A toggle switches the app to a compact layout with smaller player controls; requires a restart to take effect.

name: Toggle remote source groups
description: Three toggles enable or disable the SMB, FTP/SFTP, and Cloud source groups; disabling a group with saved resources requires confirmation.

name: Show detailed errors toggle
description: A toggle switches from simplified error messages to full error detail dialogs with stack context.

name: Saved authorizations manager
description: A navigation row opens a list of saved web sign-in sessions with options to review or clear them.

name: Send file to target toggles
description: Dynamically built per-target toggles enable or disable each Send-to destination; unavailable targets show a not-installed label.

name: Add widget to home screen picker
description: A button opens a flavor- and setting-filtered picker of pinnable home screen widgets and initiates the OS pin request.

name: Calculator widget
description: A non-resizable 1x1 home screen icon that opens the embedded in-app calculator.

name: Camera OCR Translate widget
description: A non-resizable 1x1 icon that launches the camera OCR capture and translation flow from the home screen.

name: Camera Photos widget
description: A non-resizable 1x1 icon that opens the camera photos resource in the app.

name: Quick Capture widget
description: A 1x1 icon configured with a target folder that takes a photo or records video saved directly to that folder; hidden when capture is disabled.

name: Quick Audio Recorder widget
description: A 1x1 icon that starts a voice recording on tap and stops and saves it on a second tap.

name: Capture and OCR panel widget
description: A horizontally resizable panel widget providing quick access to both the Camera Photos and Camera OCR flows.

name: Continue Reading widget
description: A resizable widget that resumes the slideshow from the last saved position.

name: Audio Now Playing widget
description: A horizontally resizable widget showing the current background audio track with play/pause, previous, next, and favorite controls.

name: Random Music widget
description: A 1x1 icon that starts playback of a random music track from the configured resource.

name: Random Photo Frame widget
description: A fully resizable widget that displays a random photo from a configured resource, refreshing periodically from a local cache.

name: Favorites widget
description: A resizable scrollable list widget showing favorite folder shortcuts; visible only when the Favorites feature is enabled.

name: Scheduled Tasks widget
description: A resizable widget displaying scheduled file operation status with Run All, Pause All, and Resume All controls; visible only when scheduling is enabled.

name: Resource Launch widget
description: A non-resizable 1x1 icon configured per-instance to open a specific resource folder from the home screen; it can be added from the resource editor or directly from a resource row's overflow menu.

name: Voice recorder widget
description: A home-screen widget and foreground service that records voice notes directly to a configured destination without opening the app.

name: All Files resource pinned first
description: The predefined All Files resource stays first in the main window resource list and grid under any sort order; hidden only when a header tab or filter excludes it.

name: Captured photo to clipboard
description: Optional setting that also places each photo taken with the in-app camera on the system clipboard as an image, ready to paste into another app, alongside the normal save and any assigned operation.

name: Video frame to clipboard
description: Optional setting that also places each frame extracted in the video player on the system clipboard as an image, ready to paste into another app, alongside the normal save to the configured destination.

name: Favorites export and import to file
description: Exports favorites to a JSON file for sharing and imports them back from a file with a skip-or-overwrite conflict choice, from the General Settings backup card.

name: Send-to for remote and cloud files
description: The player Send-to menu works for files on network (SMB/SFTP/FTP) and cloud sources, downloading a temporary local copy on demand so any receiver can act on them like a local file

name: Settings search routes backup and restore to the correct destination
description: Settings search no longer routes backup/restore to the wrong Operations/destinations tab; phantom export/import results removed

name: After an app crash, the next launch offers a one-time prompt to email the crash
description: After an app crash, the next launch offers a one-time prompt to email the crash report (with log zip) to the author

name: Favorites and resource-share export and import reachable from settings
description: Favorites and resource-share export/import are reachable again from the General settings backup card

name: D-pad and keyboard initial focus redirected off scrollable containers
description: On TV / D-pad / keyboard devices, initial focus no longer parks on a scrollable container - it lands on the first real control so on-screen controls are reachable app-wide

name: App-wide D-pad focus container guard
description: On non-touch input, a directional key that lands while focus is parked on a scrollable or paged container (or nowhere) redirects focus to the first real control inside it, so D-pad/keyboard navigation never gets stuck on a bare container after late data loads.

name: Gamepad/joystick navigation on all screens
description: On non-touch input, the left stick moves focus (D-pad equivalent with dead-zone and hold acceleration), the right stick scrolls the active container, and the shoulder buttons page-jump - on every in-house screen. The player family keeps its own transport mapping.

name: Keyboard and D-pad consistency in dialogs
description: In-house dialogs and bottom sheets respond consistently to keyboard and D-pad input: Escape dismisses, Enter confirms the positive action, arrows and Tab move focus, and a meaningful control receives initial focus on open.

name: Fallback save when destination is unavailable
description: When the selected save destination (network/cloud resource) is unavailable, screenshots, internet downloads, video frames, photos, video recordings and voice recordings are saved to the local default folder for their media type and the user is notified.

name: Mouse band-select and touch drag-select for multi-select in Browse and Duplicates
description: Mouse band-select and touch drag-select for multi-select on Browse and Duplicates lists, plus hover highlight on list items under a mouse pointer

name: Quick capture from the main overflow menu: record a voice note, video, or photo
description: Quick capture from the main overflow menu: record a voice note, video, or photo straight into the phone standard Recordings, Movies and Pictures folders; each is a separate settings toggle, gated by flavor media capability. Voice capture supports pause/resume and discard via a compact in-app indicator.

name: Quick Audio Recorder widget saves to the selected destination
description: Recordings made with the home-screen Quick Audio Recorder widget are saved to the user-selected microphone destination (the same as in-app mic recording), or to the public default audio folder when none is set, with a local fallback and notification when a network/cloud destination is unavailable - instead of a hidden private app folder.

name: Remappable browser gamepad actions
description: Browser and list gamepad buttons are now user-remappable via a new Browser actions group in the keybinding screen; the resolver is surface-aware, so one physical button can mean different things in the player and the browser.

name: Number-key shortcuts for operation buttons (keyboard and TV remote)
description: Number keys 1-9 and 0, from a hardware keyboard or TV remote, launch destination buttons of the expanded Copy and Move groups in the player, numbered continuously across both groups (Copy first, then Move); on non-touch input the buttons show the bound key as a number badge.

name: Download by link from clipboard
description: A main-menu Download by link entry, shown when link auto-download is enabled, opens a clipboard-prefilled single-line dialog and routes the link through the existing external-link download path.

name: Kryvavitsa and the Monster mini-game
description: An opt-in turn-based grid puzzle where the player moves a monster to the exit while evading enemies, with levels, score and a turn counter; supports touch, keyboard, D-pad and swipe; enabled via a Settings toggle, off by default.

name: Mini-game launcher widget
description: Home-screen widget that launches the mini-game directly; hidden from the widget picker when the embedded-game setting is disabled.

name: Loading overlay before first immersive frame
description: A 2D loading overlay covers the immersive surface while the first frame decodes off-thread, then is dismissed when the OpenXR session is ready.

name: Bundled 360 fallback image
description: Ships a CC0 equirectangular 360 image used as the immersive diagnostic fallback when no test media is present on the device.

name: Configurable 3x3 touch zones
description: A 3x3 touch-zone grid on the player maps taps and swipes to navigation, playback, brightness or volume actions.

name: Vertical brightness and volume seekbars
description: Vertical seekbars on the left and right edges of the player adjust screen brightness and volume by finger drag.

name: Chromecast video casting
description: Casts the current video to a Chromecast device through a local proxy server from the player overflow menu.

name: Custom color picker
description: A grid color picker with a custom swatch selects an arbitrary color for brush, shapes and text in the drawing editor.

name: Brush size control
description: Adjustable brush width for freehand drawing; the eraser scales with the chosen brush width.

name: Text viewer reader themes
description: Selects the background and text color scheme for plain-text and Markdown files among Light, Dark, Sepia and System.

name: PDF page share to Google Lens
description: Saves the current PDF page as an image and opens it in Google Lens for visual search or text recognition.

name: File metadata bottom sheet
description: Opens a bottom sheet with extended file metadata such as size, path and media or EXIF properties for the selected file.

name: Create new drawing canvas from Browse
description: Creates a blank drawing canvas in the current folder from the Browse overflow menu.

name: Drag to reorder resources
description: Reorders resources in the main resource list by drag and persists the new order.

name: Settings reference page
description: A complete reference of every setting and what it does, generated from the app and available in English, Russian and Ukrainian, linked from the website.

name: Unified collapsible section groups
description: Consistent collapsible section groups across settings, source editors, player panels, dialogs and lists: one animated chevron header with an optional collapsed-state summary, unified expand state persistence with seamless migration, and TalkBack expanded/collapsed announcement.

name: In-app camera controls and video
description: Unified in-app camera: capability-driven photo controls (flash, zoom presets plus slider, front/back lens switch, tap-to-focus) and in-app video recording with an explicit microphone toggle, replacing external system video capture.

name: Unified Camera entry with in-screen photo/video switch
description: The main-screen overflow menu merges the separate Photo and Video actions into one Camera action; when both photo and video are available it offers an in-screen photo/video switch, and the captured media is saved by its actual kind (photo to DCIM/Camera, video to Movies).

name: Receiving a shared link with auto-download no longer crashes the share screen; t
description: Receiving a shared link with auto-download no longer crashes the share screen; the download progress dialog now displays correctly

name: Internet Streams
description: Dedicated Streams screen for internet audio, video and RTSP sources: add a stream URL manually or import a remote .m3u playlist, pin sources to the top locally, play radio inline with ICY now-playing metadata via a sticky mini-control while the list stays visible, and open video/RTSP in the fullscreen player. RTSP (RTP-over-RTSP/TCP) and HLS/DASH VOD play on streaming flavors; lite is progressive-audio only; absent on photos.

name: Custom color themes
description: Six custom accent color themes (dark/light green, blue, red) selectable in Settings > General > Color theme, applied app-wide and persisted across restart.

name: Streams feature master toggle with per-device-profile default, a Welcome onboard
description: Streams feature master toggle with per-device-profile default, a Welcome onboarding entry, a downloadable source-catalog in the Extensions screen, and main-menu gating

name: Take a screenshot from the app Operations settings with a system capture-consent
description: Take a screenshot from the app Operations settings with a system capture-consent prompt; saved to the configured destination (standard + noLegal).

name: Background playback and exit choice for audio streams
description: Background audio playback now also governs audio streams - with background playback off a stream stops when you leave or minimize the screen, and leaving the streams list offers the same stop or keep-playing choice as the player. Background-audio settings are grouped under Background audio playback on the Player tab.

name: Filter streams by category, language and type
description: Filters the Streams list by category, language and media type (All/Audio/Video, with RTSP grouped under video). Type-to-filter searchable pickers back the category and language facets; the language picker shows flags for recognized languages and pins English, Russian and Ukrainian to the top. Facets are ANDed - selecting All on a facet disables it, so no separate match-mode toggle is needed; language-less rows stay visible under a language filter, and an active filter is marked on the filter button. The dialog follows the app color theme.

name: Stream catalog import timeout
description: Stream catalog import now fails fast on a dead or slow-trickle host instead of hanging the import spinner

name: Channel name in stream player title
description: When a video/RTSP stream is opened in the fullscreen player, the title bar and filename overlay show the human-readable channel name from the stream list instead of the raw stream URL segment; non-stream files are unaffected and unknown channels fall back to the URL-derived name.

name: Per-row play-status bullet in the streams list
description: Each stream row shows a small status bullet reflecting the last local playback attempt on this device: a green check once it has actually played here, a red exclamation if the last attempt failed (bad certificate, auth, DNS or 404), and a hollow amber circle if it has never been tried. The outcome is recorded from the real player success and error hooks for both inline audio and the fullscreen video/RTSP player, persists across restarts, and is conveyed by icon shape plus a spoken description, not colour alone.

name: Samsung-style in-app camera experience
description: One UI-aligned in-app camera: text photo/video mode selector, always-visible zoom presets, a shutter that changes shape per mode and recording state, viewfinder gestures (pinch zoom, double-tap zoom toggle, vertical swipe lens switch, horizontal swipe mode switch), a recording timer with pause/resume, a gallery thumbnail of the last capture that opens it in the in-app player, and a stay-open multi-capture session for the general Camera entry that saves each shot without closing.

name: Dropdown and selection settings are findable in settings search
description: Settings search now indexes dropdown and selection setting rows (Language, Color theme, Video pre-cache size, Default sort mode, Device profile, Saved authorizations, Statistics), so these settings can be found by typing in the settings search field.

name: Settings search hides rows for features your edition lacks
description: Settings search no longer returns rows for features the current edition does not include: microphone recording, background audio playback, cloud sources, OCR and on-screen translation, and the downloadable extensions screen are hidden from search results on editions that lack them, so a search match always leads to a visible setting.

name: Standalone image viewer: print, copy and move
description: The standalone image viewer (images opened from another app) can print the picture through the unified Send-to menu and copy or move the current file into configured destination folders from Copy to / Move to button groups at the bottom.

name: Copy or move an externally-opened file to a configured destination folder direct
description: Copy or move an externally-opened file to a configured destination folder directly from the standalone audio, document and text viewers - copying keeps the viewer open, moving relocates the file and closes the viewer.

name: Print documents and text from the standalone viewer
description: Print a PDF, Office document, or text file opened from another app, directly from the standalone viewer via the unified Send-to menu.

name: Edge-gesture screenshot (Play consent)
description: On standard, enabling the left-edge gesture strip lets a diagonal swipe capture the current screen through a per-shot MediaProjection consent dialog and save it to a chosen resource or the device screenshots folder. No accessibility service is used.

name: Bounded SFTP folder scan with timeout error
description: SFTP folder scans end in bounded time with a clear, retryable error instead of an endless loading spinner when the network changes or a connection goes half-open.

name: Stream-tailored control set in the player
description: When a live video stream opens in the fullscreen player it shows only the controls that apply to a live feed - fullscreen, frame snapshot, rotation, file info, picture-in-picture, the video control dialog, Chrome Cast and Send to - and hides file-only actions such as delete, rename, edit, copy, move, slideshow, favorite and sleep timer. Send to shares the stream link as text (any messenger, clipboard, SMS or email receives the URL) instead of trying to download the live stream as a file. Ordinary video, audio, image and document files keep their full control set unchanged.

name: Live video stream casting to Chromecast
description: Casts a live video stream (HLS, DASH or progressive HTTP) directly to a Chromecast device by handing the stream URL to the receiver as a live stream, without downloading it first; RTSP streams report that the protocol can't be cast.

name: Live stream auto-recovery instead of channel-removal dialog
description: A live video stream (HLS/DASH) that falls behind its sliding live window is silently re-anchored to the live edge and resumed, instead of being reported as a dead channel with a retry/remove dialog and a red status. Transient network drops and retryable server responses (HTTP 429 and 5xx) are retried with bounded backoff; permanent failures (HTTP 4xx, malformed manifest, unsupported container) still surface the dialog at once. The player tracks the live edge via a live-target offset and a modest live buffer so it stops sticking to the expiring segment.

name: Edge-gesture action: open the app
description: An additional left-edge gesture action that brings the app to the foreground (restoring its previous state if already running, otherwise launching it) without taking a screenshot or showing a capture-consent prompt.

name: Stream home-screen shortcut
description: Pin a specific internet stream to the home screen: pick a channel in the Streams list and place a one-tap launch shortcut that plays that channel directly.

name: Stream player channel navigation
description: In the fullscreen player for a video stream, the top previous/next buttons move to the previous/next video channel in the Streams list (catalog order) and re-source the player, instead of acting as in-collection file navigation.

name: Stream player trimmed on-screen controls
description: The on-player overlay for a video stream shows only play/pause, the video-control dialog button, and Picture-in-Picture; the seek bar, timings, playback-order toggle, file previous/next, and rewind/forward are hidden as inapplicable to a live stream.

name: Stream player hides copy and move panels
description: The Copy-to and Move-to destination button panels are hidden in the fullscreen player for a video stream, since copying or moving a file does not apply to a live stream.

name: Playback control dialog section navigation adapts to orientation (vertical rail
description: Playback control dialog section navigation adapts to orientation (vertical rail in portrait, horizontal strip in landscape) and stays fully reachable; dialog height bounded to screen

name: Optional 9-zone touch grid
description: Turn off the 9-zone touch grid for a simpler previous / zoom / next fullscreen player layout, with a left-edge command-panel area for file actions.

name: Edge-gesture action: open app panel
description: A left-edge gesture action that opens a quick-launch panel of large app tiles in a fixed grid (3x5 portrait, 5x3 landscape) for one-tap launching of FastMediaSorter and pinned external apps, with a separate Edit screen to add, move, replace or remove tiles. Opens without taking a screenshot or showing a capture-consent prompt; unavailable apps are hidden.

name: Settings navigation rows unified to a single real-arrow etalon: arrow sits right
description: Settings navigation rows unified to a single real-arrow etalon: arrow sits right after the text (no full-width stretch), leading icon and hint preserved, portrait and landscape.

name: General settings: the compact-elements toggle and background-sync interval are n
description: General settings: the compact-elements toggle and background-sync interval are now both available in portrait and landscape (previously each was missing in one orientation)

name: Sorted headline clarified and flushed on open
description: The Statistics dashboard and text report now label the Sorted headline as copied plus moved files, and opening Statistics immediately after a completed copy or move flushes pending local counters so the card does not briefly show 0 inside the debounce window.

name: Expanded metric coverage
description: The statistics dashboard and exported report now also cover file renames, favorites added and removed, slideshow sessions and slides shown, scheduled-operation runs and files processed, stream plays, stream sources added, playlist imports, GIF frame saves, undone operations, and text recognitions. New rows reuse the existing category layout and zero-row hiding.

name: Simple value-selection across settings unified to one minimalistic tap-row + lis
description: Simple value-selection across settings unified to one minimalistic tap-row + list-dialog pattern

name: Welcome onboarding now surfaces a Statistics collection toggle (on by default);
description: Welcome onboarding now surfaces a Statistics collection toggle (on by default); local anonymous operation statistics

name: Settings list-value trigger rows now show the selector chevron right after the t
description: Settings list-value trigger rows now show the selector chevron right after the text (unified row etalon, portrait + landscape)

name: Download-resource and screenshot-destination settings rows now use the same labe
description: Download-resource and screenshot-destination settings rows now use the same label + value + Select button pattern as the camera/video folder selectors

name: Welcome gesture enablement
description: Onboarding toggle to enable left-edge gestures, preconfigured on install: swipe up opens the launch menu, swipe right captures and opens the editor, swipe down captures silently with a toast.

name: TV-remote and mouse input parity on the Streams screen
description: The Streams list and its dialogs are fully operable by TV remote, keyboard and mouse: right-clicking a stream row opens its action menu, every streams dialog closes on Escape and confirms its primary action on Enter, and D-pad focus moves cleanly between the search field, the filter and sort buttons, the list and the mini-player stop button.

name: App panel: OS shortcuts and the app's own features/resources
description: The quick-launch app panel can hold not only external apps but also parts of the operating system (Settings, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Display, Sound, Battery, Storage, App info, Date/time - only those that resolve on the device) and the app's own features and resources (calculator, mini-game, photo-OCR-translate, streams, a specific resource), chosen via a three-path add flow; the panel also ships pre-populated by default with our features first then Settings, leaving empty slots for the user's apps.

name: Stream card actions menu
