description: Each stream card's overflow (three-dot) menu groups channel commands - add to home screen, edit (manual channels), send link, remove - so secondary actions are no longer hidden behind gestures.

name: Player auto-switches to fullscreen on rotate to landscape and shows the command
description: Player auto-switches to fullscreen on rotate to landscape and shows the command panel on rotate to portrait, without interrupting playback, in both the standalone and stream players

name: Streams settings now offer a default sort order, a default media-type filter, a
description: Streams settings now offer a default sort order, a default media-type filter, a channel-list refresh policy, and a clear-play-marks action; the Streams screen remembers the last search and filter on reopen.

name: Compact context-aware playback control dialog
description: Playback control dialog: context-aware tabs (3D only on VR builds; audio/subtitle tabs hidden when not selectable), distinct Volume vs Audio track tabs, quick speed presets 0.5x/1.5x/2x, compact height

name: Play MediaProjection capture suite
description: Ships the Play-safe screenshot suite on standard: take a screenshot through per-session system consent, then copy it to the clipboard, open it in the drawing editor, run on-device OCR-translate, send it via Send To, and save it to a configured or fallback folder.

name: Channel favicon thumbnails in the stream catalog
description: Each stream-catalog row shows a recognizable per-channel favicon thumbnail sliced from a single sprite-atlas PNG bundled inside the downloadable catalog archive (offline-built from each channel homepage); channels without a favicon show an empty slot. The atlas and its coordinate column are backward-compatible - older app versions ignore them without crashing.

name: Actionable streams-catalog empty state
description: When the streams catalog has no sources, the empty state shows an icon plus inline Add-stream and Import-list buttons that open the same dialogs as the toolbar actions, so recovery is one tap instead of finding the toolbar glyphs.

name: Stream browser grid mode: live channels shown as tiles with a captured current f
description: Stream browser grid mode: live channels shown as tiles with a captured current frame, list/grid toggle persisted across sessions, snapshot-and-release capture with concurrency limit and TTL cache

name: Edge-gesture action: crop screenshot and share
description: A left-edge gesture action that captures the screen, immediately reopens the screenshot with a draggable crop frame, overwrites it with the cropped result, then opens the app Send to menu (print, social, email) targeting the cropped image.

name: Select resource entry
description: Send-to menu ends with a permanent 'Select resource..' entry that copies the current file to a destination resource (or a custom folder via '..') from the player and all standalone players, mirroring the file browser Copy-to dialog.

name: Crop tool in the draw editor
description: Crop the working image to a draggable rectangle inside the draw editor - full resolution for local files - then keep annotating before saving or sharing.

name: Stream wait-phase label: buffering vs reconnecting
description: While a network stream is loading, the player shows a caption under the spinner that tells the user which wait is happening: buffering (filling the memory buffer) or reconnecting (re-establishing a dropped connection). Localized in English, Russian and Ukrainian. The stream buffer is also tuned for steadier playback on an unstable connection without regressing live-edge tracking.

name: Bandwidth-adaptive stream buffer
description: The internet-stream player sizes its playback buffer to the measured connection speed at runtime: on a weak or unstable link it builds a deeper cushion so a stream rides out throughput dips instead of stalling into the loading spinner, and on a healthy link it stays modest. Live HLS/DASH streams keep their live-safe buffer depth so they still track the live edge without falling behind.

name: Re-tap to stop an inline stream
description: Tapping a stream that is already playing inline stops it, so one gesture both starts and stops playback.

name: Duplicate parenthetical title suppression
description: Stream titles of the form Name (Name) render as Name; a differing parenthetical (region/quality) is kept.

name: Multi-column stream list in landscape
description: The stream list shows two or more columns in landscape and recomputes the column count on rotation.

name: Fullscreen stream video player
description: Opening a video stream goes straight to immersive fullscreen; a surface tap reveals the top command bar and bottom controls without the media players touch zones.

name: Long-press to pin a stream
description: Long-pressing a stream row or tile pins or unpins it to the top of the list.

name: Pinned-only stream filter
description: The stream filter can limit the list to streams the user pinned.

name: Remembered stream filter and sort
description: The chosen stream filter, media kind, sort, and search query are restored on the next launch.

name: Remembered stream list position
description: The stream list returns to the same item the user last viewed after a restart.

name: Stream health probe on refresh
description: The refresh action checks each visible stream for reachability and marks it green or red, refreshing grid thumbnails, and stops on any user interaction.

name: Grid tile status dot and overflow menu
description: Grid tiles show a play-status dot in the lower-left corner and a three-dot command menu in the upper-right corner.

name: Landscape-style layout now triggers by minimum available width (>=600dp) in addi
description: Landscape-style layout now triggers by minimum available width (>=600dp) in addition to landscape orientation, so wide high-resolution devices held in portrait get the wide layout instead of collapsing content to the top-left.

name: Offline stream play soft-fail
description: Streams refuse to play with a quick no-network message instead of spinning when the device has no Wi-Fi or mobile data.

name: Standard edge-gesture and tile capture triggers
description: On the standard Play flavor, screen capture can be triggered from the edge-gesture family - an opt-in edge strip (specialUse FGS) with configurable directional capture/share actions and an app-launch panel, plus a Quick Settings tile fallback that captures via MediaProjection consent without a persistent overlay. Both triggers ship gated off by default, enabled per build pending Play review of the specialUse declaration.

name: Per-zone gesture strip visibility
description: Each of the four edge-gesture zone blocks (upper/lower left, upper/lower right) has its own toggle that shows a semi-transparent grey guide on the first 4 px of that band's screen edge - left bands on the left edge, right bands on the right - leaving the rest of the band transparent. Each toggle is independent, defaults off, applies to the live strip immediately while the gesture overlay is enabled; the pre-existing single left-strip setting migrates into the upper-left zone.

name: Database reset recovery notice
description: When the local database cannot be opened or migrated, the app backs up the existing database files and shows a dialog explaining the reset and where the backup was saved, instead of silently wiping data.

name: Static analysis gate (detekt + ktlint)
description: Developer-facing detekt plus ktlint formatting gate over app_v2 and wear Kotlin sources with frozen ratchet baselines; runs locally and via post-change.ps1, failing only on new findings. Separate from the runtime build (not wired into assemble).

name: Listener symmetry ratchet gate
description: Developer-facing lexical gate over app_v2 and wear Kotlin sources that freezes the current register/unregister and add/remove Listener/Callback/Observer imbalance, then fails only on new drift. Runs directly via script and from post-change.ps1 on Kotlin or Mixed changes.

name: Camera zoom presets, zoom slider & night mode
description: In-app camera: zoom presets 0.5-30x with a draggable zoom slider, overlay controls legible on any background, and a device-gated photo night mode.

name: Listener symmetry ratchet gate
description: Developer-facing cheap lexical check verifying matching register/unregister and add/remove listener calls, integrated into post-change.ps1 with a ratchet baseline.

name: Architectural custom Lint rules module
description: Custom Android Lint rules module (:lint-rules) with AST detectors validating Activity logic delegation, UI context leak prevention, repeatOnLifecycle Flow usage, player resource release, and main-thread I/O checks.

name: Instrumented memory leak detection
description: On-demand instrumented leak detection runner using LeakCanary inside instrumented tests to verify UI flow lifecycle and fail on leak detection.

name: Quick Launch Panel in programs menu
description: The Quick Launch Panel can now be opened from the main window programs (three-dots) menu, in addition to the edge gesture, Quick Settings tile, and widget.

name: Exit button minimizes when background functions are active
description: The top-left exit button minimizes the app (keeping background music, recording, scheduled file operations and the edge-gesture overlay alive) instead of closing it whenever any such function is active; it fully closes only when nothing runs in the background, and a long-press always force-closes after a brief 'background stopped' toast.

name: Stream country metadata with filter and sort
description: Shows each catalog channel's country as a flag+code chip before the language chip in the stream list, and lets you filter and sort the stream list by country. The country comes from the curated catalog (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code); channels without a known country stay visible and sort last.

name: Photo GPS geotagging (opt-in)
description: Optionally embeds the device GPS location in the EXIF of photos taken with the in-app camera. Opt-in via Operations > Camera (off by default), requests location permission on enable, and never blocks the shutter when no fix or permission is available. Works for full-frame and digital-zoom shots and for camera launches from widgets.

name: Programs panel on the main window
description: Optional horizontal panel mirroring the programs three-dots menu above the resource list; icons in portrait, icons plus labels in landscape, overflow for items that do not fit; hides the three-dots button while shown. Default off.

name: Streams panel on the main window
description: Optional horizontal panel above the resource list with a Streams entry button followed by pinned channels in pin order; channel chips show a favicon thumbnail and/or a short name chosen by window width; tapping a channel plays it. Default off, requires Streams enabled.

name: Context menu on main-window panel items
description: Each item on the main-window programs and streams panels has a three-dots button (when labels show) or long-press menu to open it, open it in a separate window when multi-window is available, or remove it from the panel - disabling the program in settings, or unpinning the channel. Body tap still opens or plays the item directly.

name: Fixed camera controls, Send To and settings dialog
description: In-app camera keeps controls physically fixed while icons rotate, shows the active save destination, adds a Send To action for the latest capture, and exposes capability-driven settings such as timer, grid, aspect ratio, resolution, exposure, white balance, manual ISO/shutter and HDR when supported.

name: Screen video recording from the programs block: whole-screen MediaProjection cap
description: Screen video recording from the programs block: whole-screen MediaProjection capture with microphone audio via a foreground service, pause/resume and stop from a compact in-app indicator (shared with quick voice capture) or the notification, saved to the chosen resource or Downloads.

name: Persistent last-frame stream thumbnails
description: Grid mode saves each captured live video-stream frame to app-private storage and re-shows it as the channel thumbnail on next launch, so a known http(s) video channel appears with its last frame immediately instead of a blank/favicon tile, then refreshes to a live frame.

name: Context icons on Settings and Welcome
description: Settings collapsible group headers and feature toggle rows, plus the Welcome functionality and network pages, show a monochrome icon of the matching feature (images, video, audio, documents, streams, network sources, file browser, calculator, capture, mic and screen recording, OCR, translation, gestures, scheduled operations) to the left of the label, so features stay recognisable when labels are small.

name: Inline audio playback from the main-window streams panel
description: Tapping an audio (radio) channel on the main-window streams panel plays it inline in the home window with a bottom now-playing bar (channel name, ICY track, stop button), without opening the streams list screen; re-tapping the same channel stops it. Video channels still open the streams screen.

name: Configure shortcut in main-window panel menus
description: Long-press menus of the main-window programs panel and the streams entry button include a Configure item that opens Settings directly on the relevant group with that section expanded and scrolled into view.

name: Collapse resource-type filter strip
description: Long-press the main-window resource-type tabs to collapse them into a colored label strip; tap the strip to expand. The collapsed state persists across app restarts.

name: Hide the main-window streams panel from its entry menu
description: Long-pressing the main-window Streams panel entry button now offers a 'Hide panel' action that hides only the panel while keeping Streams enabled, so the Streams button returns to the programs panel/menu. It is distinct from 'Disable', which turns the whole Streams feature off; re-enable the panel via Settings -> Streams.

name: Add live channels to Favorites
description: Add a live channel to the shared Favorites list (when Favorites is enabled); it shows by channel name and opens in the stream player, independent of pinning.

name: Country flag fallback in streams list
description: Shows the channel country flag in the streams-list leading icon slot when the channel has no favicon atlas tile, keeping row alignment

name: Take a photo (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that captures a photo headlessly - no camera screen opens - and saves it to the device camera folder with a confirming toast. Only the system camera-in-use indicator appears briefly; a fully silent capture is not possible on Android.

name: Take a photo and send to.. (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that auto-captures a photo and then opens it in the standalone viewer with the send-to menu.

name: Take a photo and edit (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that auto-captures a photo and then opens it directly in the draw/edit tools.

name: Take a photo and OCR-translate (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that auto-captures a photo and then runs OCR-translate on it. Hidden when the translation capability is not available.

name: Start video recording (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that opens the camera fixed in video mode, ready to record; the clip saves to the public Movies folder.

name: Start audio recording (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that starts the quick voice recorder; repeating the gesture stops and saves the recording.

name: Start screen recording (edge gesture)
description: A left-edge gesture action that starts screen video recording via the app disclosure plus the system MediaProjection consent; repeating the gesture stops and saves. Hidden on flavors without the capture engine.

name: Open app settings from the browse menu
description: The file browser overflow menu has a bottom-pinned 'App settings' entry that opens the main Settings window directly, without returning to the home screen.

name: Mini-game visual modes
description: Switchable visual skins for the mini-game: Classic (abstract shapes) and Kryvavitsa (light-gray field, black walls, human silhouettes, a door exit and stomping movement). The chosen mode persists across launches and the help legend follows the active mode.

name: Programs panel header menu
description: The main-window programs panel starts with a three-dots header button opening a panel menu: Configure panel (jumps to the Additional programs and scenarios settings), Collapse panel (folds the row into a labelled strip that a tap re-expands; the collapsed state persists across restarts), and Hide panel (removes the panel and restores the three-dots button in the top command bar).

name: Streams panel collapse
description: The main-window streams panel entry button long-press menu gains a Collapse panel item that folds the panel into a labelled Streams.. strip; a tap on the strip re-expands it, and the collapsed state persists across restarts.

name: Camera scenario context label
description: The in-app camera shows a context label naming the current scenario (text recognition) above the zoom presets so the user remembers why the camera was opened; hidden for generic capture.

name: Collapsed panels grouped in one row
description: Collapsed main-window panels (programs / streams / resource-type filter) group their labels as compact chips in one shared row above the resource list instead of separate full-width strips; tapping a chip expands that panel back to its place, and an empty row takes no vertical space.

name: Long-press name labels
description: Long-pressing a main-window element reveals its name: the programs-item / streams-entry / channel context menus gain a greyed non-clickable name header at the top, and the icon-only top command-bar buttons show their name via a tooltip - making icon-only controls understandable.

name: Travelling D-pad / TV focus frame
description: A single highlighted frame follows keyboard, D-pad and gamepad focus across every screen, form and dialog so the focused item is always visible; it shows only under remote/gamepad control, not touch. In the player, arrows move focus between the on-screen transport controls.

name: Macrobenchmark, Baseline Profile and Perfetto perf harness
description: Developer-facing macrobenchmark, baseline profile and Perfetto workflow for the standard flavor: stable local commands measure cold start, browse/player readiness and back-navigation, and the same journeys generate a baseline profile for release builds.

name: Network video playback keeps thumbnail suspension until playback truly ends - a
description: Network video playback keeps thumbnail suspension until playback truly ends - a stale 300ms resume job no longer clears the active flag mid-stream, so previews are not wrongly marked as permanently failed

name: Double-tapping the same inline audio stream during the service connect no longer
description: Double-tapping the same inline audio stream during the service connect no longer leaves an orphaned background player - a stale play callback now stops the just-started player instead of resurrecting it

name: Standalone document viewer no longer leaks a PdfRenderer, file descriptor or Web
description: Standalone document viewer no longer leaks a PdfRenderer, file descriptor or WebView when paging between mixed-type documents (PDF/EPUB/Office) - teardown now releases every initialized viewer, not just the active type

name: Read Aloud (TTS) no longer keeps playing or leaks its engine when the player scr
description: Read Aloud (TTS) no longer keeps playing or leaks its engine when the player screen is recreated (theme/font change or 'Don't keep activities'); TTS state updates are now confined to the main thread

name: The deprecated standalone player no longer crashes on teardown when launched wit
description: The deprecated standalone player no longer crashes on teardown when launched with a default-player probe URI or destroyed on the first frame - the view-manager release is now guarded against an uninitialized state

name: Open video files in fullscreen mode
description: Video files opened from Browse can launch straight into fullscreen playback, controlled by a new Video Settings toggle - on by default for every device profile except Audio Player and E-book Reader.

name: Player settings dialog redesigned to canonical header/actions layout - title no
description: Player settings dialog redesigned to canonical header/actions layout - title no longer wraps in portrait

name: Enable-all onboarding: OCR/translation toggles no longer silently revert when bo
description: Enable-all onboarding: OCR/translation toggles no longer silently revert when both engine installs complete near-simultaneously (serialized settings writers)

name: Crash-free account save during rotation
description: Browser sign-in: saving an account no longer risks a crash when the screen rotates while the session is being stored

name: Network folders (SMB): connection-degradation recovery reacts on time under para
description: Network folders (SMB): connection-degradation recovery reacts on time under parallel load (timeout strike counting no longer loses events)

name: Standalone player: manual pause survives background/resume, SAF rename no longer
description: Standalone player: manual pause survives background/resume, SAF rename no longer restarts playback from 0

name: Background/inline audio (slideshow music, Browse mic/inline audio, Streams OFF-m
description: Background/inline audio (slideshow music, Browse mic/inline audio, Streams OFF-mode, wear) now correctly requests and abandons audio focus - ducks/pauses for other apps, survives split-screen multi-window instead of stopping when one window closes

name: Player subsystem correctness fixes: BD-TS local video now uses the tuned playbac
description: Player subsystem correctness fixes: BD-TS local video now uses the tuned playback pipeline, Now Playing sheet stops polling when backgrounded, VR launch no longer crashes on a settings-write hiccup, stream error-recovery no longer disturbs the next file's position

name: Colour-coded main-window panels
description: Each collapsible main-window panel (programs, streams, resource-type filter) has its own accent background shown in both expanded and collapsed state, with a recognisable icon on the collapsed chip.

name: App panel: quick camera, voice, screen recording, and link download
description: The quick-launch app panel can now also hold quick camera capture, quick voice recording, screen recording, and download-by-link - the same functions already available from the main window's Programs and Scenarios menu - each gated by the same build/runtime rules as its main-window counterpart.

name: Floating stop indicator for quick audio recording
description: Quick audio recording started from the home widget or an edge gesture shows a small floating indicator with a Stop control on top of whatever app is open, in addition to the existing notification and repeat-gesture ways to stop it.

name: Settings - Management - Destinations: confirm-delete and confirm-move toggles no
description: Settings - Management - Destinations: confirm-delete and confirm-move toggles now render as two full-width rows in portrait instead of squeezed side-by-side columns

name: Settings > Management > OS Interaction: system-media-handler and accept-shared-f
description: Settings > Management > OS Interaction: system-media-handler and accept-shared-files toggles stack in two full-width rows in portrait; unchanged in landscape

name: Reorder pinned streams
description: Reorder pinned streams (move up / down / to top) from the streams list and grid three-dot menu; order honoured by the main-window panel and channel selection.

name: App-wide focus indicator for remote/D-pad
description: On devices without touch, the currently focused control is highlighted with an accent outline drawn in place on the control itself, shown app-wide only in non-touch (remote/keyboard/gamepad) mode; the player video/artwork surface itself is excluded so playback screens never draw the outline around the video.

name: Automatic initial focus on every screen
description: On devices without touch, opening any screen places focus on a real control automatically, so the first remote/D-pad key acts immediately instead of being spent waking focus.

name: Standalone document viewer: tap a PDF hyperlink to open it, long-press to select
description: Standalone document viewer: tap a PDF hyperlink to open it, long-press to select page text; legacy player pages PDFs with a vertical swipe.

name: More OS settings tiles in the quick-launch panel
description: The quick-launch panel Android settings catalog adds Developer options, Battery saver, Auto-rotate, Accessibility, Wireless networks, Data usage, NFC and VPN tiles; each appears only when its settings screen resolves on the device.

name: Quick-launch panel pickers (app / feature / OS shortcut / resource) now show a s
description: Quick-launch panel pickers (app / feature / OS shortcut / resource) now show a search-filter for long lists and a consistent single-choice UI with leading icons.

name: VR install CTA no longer appears on the vr flavor when opening 3D content (it wr
description: VR install CTA no longer appears on the vr flavor when opening 3D content (it wrongly prompted to install the VR edition while already running it).

name: OCR and DTS native modules are now bundled in the APK, so they work on Google Pl
description: OCR and DTS native modules are now bundled in the APK, so they work on Google Play standard installs instead of showing a misleading 'delivered via Google Play' unavailable message.

name: Audio-related permissions are no longer silently disabled on minified release bu
description: Audio-related permissions are no longer silently disabled on minified release builds (the flavor gate used reflection that R8 broke); the gate now resolves BuildConfig flags directly.

name: Camera/video gesture actions as panel functions
description: The quick-access (app-launch) panel function picker now offers the camera/video actions from the left-edge gestures: take a photo and send-to, take a photo and edit, take a photo and OCR-translate, and start a video recording.

name: Quick-launch panel close button
description: The quick-launch panel dialog shows an explicit close (X) button before the title, so it can be dismissed with a tap in addition to Back or tapping outside.

name: Windows companion one-action SFTP import
description: Imports a .fmscfg config exported by the FastMediaSorter Windows companion (folder-share helper): one file pick creates ready-to-use read-only SFTP resources per shared folder with the embedded credential and TOFU-pinned host key - no manual host/port/key entry.

name: Viber receiver
description: Shares one file to the installed Viber app and falls back to the system chooser if direct dispatch is unavailable.

name: Messenger receiver
description: Shares one file to the installed Messenger app and falls back to the system chooser if direct dispatch is unavailable.

name: Short-video social receiver
description: Shares one image, GIF, or video to an installed compatible short-video social app and uses the first file from a multi-selection.

name: Share SFTP resource access as a file
description: Exports a chosen SFTP resource to a .fmscfg config file (optional password omission, private-network reachability warning) and hands it to the system share sheet for Telegram or email.

name: One-tap import of a shared SFTP access file
description: Tapping a received .fmscfg attachment from Telegram or email opens a confirm dialog (with a password field when the file carries none) and creates the ready-to-use SFTP resource.

name: Companion QR scan import
description: Scans a companion QR code with the camera to add the shared PC folders as read-only SFTP resources in one step with no file; decodes both plain and compressed payloads through the shared parser and TOFU host-key pin; scan entry point hidden on camera-less and VR devices.

name: Configurable edge-swipe gestures across four screen-edge bands
description: Up to twelve screenshot and quick-action gestures: four independently toggleable screen-edge bands (two left, two right) each with upward, inward and downward swipes.

name: Contrast mini-game mode and start-of-level exit arrow
description: Adds a third high-contrast mini-game mode that draws floor, walls, exit and all actors as solid full-colour tiles for small-screen readability, with a stepped move animation plus a fading source ghost so an identical cube's direction stays clear; and, in every mode, a ~1s arrow from the player to the nearest exit at level start to speed up orientation on large maps.

name: Resource config import entry points
description: Import a ready resource configuration from the Add-resource screen: Import-from-file and Import-by-barcode entries sit next to the four resource-type cards and in the SFTP form header, reusing the companion .fmscfg file and QR import; the barcode entry is hidden on camera-less devices.

name: Companion publish-folders guide link
description: In-app help links on the Add Resource screen and in Settings open the PC-side guide for publishing folders to Android over SFTP; hidden where companion import is unavailable.

name: SFTP resource with a missing host path now shows a friendly 'not found' message
description: SFTP resource with a missing host path now shows a friendly 'not found' message instead of a generic error

name: Companion config import/export upgraded to schema v2: an imported companion reso
description: Companion config import/export upgraded to schema v2: an imported companion resource now arrives fully configured (type/profile such as audio library, media types, scan conditions, destination, comment, PIN, slideshow interval) over both the .fmscfg file and the QR/barcode; older v1 files still import unchanged.

name: Resource statistics persist after browsing
description: Resource statistics (file count, subfolder count, last opened, last sync) are written when a resource is browsed and are no longer reset to zero or never by leaving the screen or opening a file; cloud resources record last sync time on browse.

name: Live streams that silently freeze (stuck buffering with no error) now auto-recov
description: Live streams that silently freeze (stuck buffering with no error) now auto-recover: a watchdog re-anchors and re-prepares the stream up to 3 times showing Reconnecting, and falls back to the channel-unavailable dialog when the network stays dead

name: Resource profile is now one unified dialog titled Resource Profile in both the a
description: Resource profile is now one unified dialog titled Resource Profile in both the add-resource forms and the resource editor; choosing File Manager profile no longer hides the media-types togglers in the editor, and profile presets set the same media types everywhere

name: Product-branded splash screen
description: The cold-start splash shows the app logo and Fast Media Sorter wordmark fading in at center, with the author logo moved to the small bottom-center branding slot.

name: Filter dialog, Settings search, and other single-line text fields stay reachable
description: Filter dialog, Settings search, and other single-line text fields stay reachable above the keyboard on wide/landscape screens instead of disappearing behind Android's fullscreen keyboard mode

name: Auto-reachable companion SFTP endpoint
description: A companion SFTP resource imported from one QR or config connects over whichever address is reachable now - the home LAN when nearby, the internet port-forward address when away - and follows the phone between Wi-Fi and mobile networks without re-importing.

name: Auto-discover companion server on the local network
description: On the same Wi-Fi, the app finds the companion SFTP server by its advertised host key and connects over its live local address - so a shared folder opens even if the scanned QR carried no or an outdated LAN address, or the PC changed address on the network.

name: Guidance when a shared folder cannot be reached
description: When a companion or network SFTP resource fails to connect, the app shows actionable guidance instead of a bare timeout - the sharing app's own access note when the config carried one, otherwise how to enable access (same Wi-Fi, port forwarding, or the companion setup).

name: Import a companion-shared folder as writable
description: A folder shared from the Windows companion imports as writable (upload, rename, delete, move-into) when the sharer marks it writable, instead of always view-only; folders without the flag and shares from older companion versions stay read-only.

name: Manually-added HTTP stream URLs with embedded Basic-Auth credentials (http://use
description: Manually-added HTTP stream URLs with embedded Basic-Auth credentials (http://user:pass@host/...) now authenticate correctly instead of failing as unreachable

name: Screenshot into OCR crop flow
description: Screenshot OCR/translate (and the take-photo, app-launch panel, and OCR widget entry points) open the same crop + language-selection + OCR/translate screen as photos, with the screenshot as source; only the cropped frame is saved to the gallery.

name: Share an SFTP resource as a QR code from the resource menu; the recipient scans
description: Share an SFTP resource as a QR code from the resource menu; the recipient scans it to add the resource instantly.

name: Secure sensitive screens
description: Blocks screenshots and the Recents preview on credential-bearing screens (Add/Edit Resource, Settings authorization, the login WebView, and the credential-sharing QR) via a targeted FLAG_SECURE, gated by a user setting that defaults ON.

name: Edge-gesture configuration dialog
description: Dedicated full-screen dialog for edge-gesture setup: interactive zone map (grey=available, red=assigned) with tap-to-assign, four per-zone tabs (direction actions + strip visibility), and a general group (screenshot destination, clipboard, app-panel editor, accessibility rows). The Operations tab keeps only the master toggle plus a launcher; landscape uses a two-column layout.

name: Animated WebP and APNG playback
description: Animated WebP and APNG images play in the viewer like GIFs

name: Fail-fast on unreachable destination
description: Batch transfer aborts fast with a clear message when the destination server is unreachable

name: Uniform button grid across top panels
description: The command bar, programs panel, streams panel, and resource-type tabs above the main resource list share one aligned button grid in portrait, using the programs panel button width as the shared module.

name: Draw editor Save-as now always writes a real file extension - editor-saved scree
description: Draw editor Save-as now always writes a real file extension - editor-saved screenshots, frames and edits no longer land without an extension.

name: Scheduled-operations master toggle on the Operations settings screen auto-reconc
description: Scheduled-operations master toggle on the Operations settings screen auto-reconciles to the list - an empty list unchecks it, a non-empty list re-checks it (settings-screen only, idempotent, debounced).

name: Video player now shows transport controls on open and re-reveals them on center-
description: Video player now shows transport controls on open and re-reveals them on center-tap after auto-hide

name: Screenshot-gesture edge bands stay flush to screen edges after rotation
description: Screenshot-gesture edge bands stay flush to screen edges after rotation

name: Streams search field and filter reset when leaving and re-entering the streams s
description: Streams search field and filter reset when leaving and re-entering the streams screen

name: Sensitive screens (settings, resource add/edit) blank in Recents and block scree
description: Sensitive screens (settings, resource add/edit) blank in Recents and block screenshots when secure setting is on

name: OCR crop bottom handle stays grabbable clear of the bottom action bar and the cr
description: OCR crop bottom handle stays grabbable clear of the bottom action bar and the crop border renders fully

name: Main-screen top panels (programs, streams, resource tabs) align their first butt
description: Main-screen top panels (programs, streams, resource tabs) align their first button to the same left edge

name: Grid tile pin/unpin menu item + pinned badge
description: In the streams grid, each tile's menu leads with a Pin or Unpin item (label reflects the current state); a pinned tile shows a small red Pinned badge in the top-left corner over the thumbnail. The badge is an indicator only - pinning is changed through the menu.

name: Main-screen top command bar buttons now align in a uniform column with the progr
description: Main-screen top command bar buttons now align in a uniform column with the programs/streams/tabs panels (portrait), matching the 48dp finger-friendly module

name: Camera launch widget
description: A home screen widget that opens the in-app camera to take a photo or record video, saving captures to the public device folders. Now offered in the Add-widget picker.

name: Launch widget captions
description: Home screen launch widgets show a text label beneath their icon (icon over caption, like an app shortcut), so each widget is identifiable without memorizing its glyph.

name: Camera preview matches the saved file
description: The in-app camera preview now equals the saved file: a result frame marks the file bounds when the selected format is narrower than the shown sensor frame, the chosen aspect ratio persists between capture sessions, and digital-zoom video is cropped into the recorded file instead of the preview only.

name: Hint on the empty main-window streams panel
description: The main-window streams panel no longer sits blank when it is switched on but nothing is pinned: in place of the channel list it now shows a small-font hint inviting you to pin streams. The hint disappears as soon as the first channel is pinned, and never shows while the panel is collapsed or hidden.

name: Registered media type for archives and disk images in Open-with and Share
description: Open with / Share now hands archives and disk images (.iso, .7z, .rar, .dmg, ..) a real registered file type instead of a made-up one, so apps that specifically handle those formats show up in the chooser.

name: HEIC, HEIF and AVIF image support
description: HEIC/HEIF (Android 9+) and AVIF (Android 12+) images are scanned, thumbnailed, viewed and sortable like any other image; on older Android versions the viewer shows a clear minimum-version notice instead of failing.

name: Launcher mode (device home screen)
description: Turn the app into your device's home screen. Once you opt in and pick it from the system chooser, pressing Home opens a Windows-style desktop you build yourself: a grid of shortcut cells (open a folder in a view mode, start a playlist, tune a stream channel, or launch any installed app) plus live gadgets (clock, playlist, stream list, folder preview). A taskbar stays visible with a Start menu, recent launches, pinned apps and a tray. The first time you switch it on, the desktop comes pre-filled to match your device profile, portrait and landscape are arranged independently, and you can always leave launcher mode and return to your previous home screen.

name: Windows companion promo on onboarding network sources
description: The onboarding Network sources page shows a short note and a link opening the Fast Media Sorter for Windows site, where the desktop companion publishes PC folders over SMB/SFTP so they appear as network sources here; hidden on flavors without local-network support.

name: Companion import add-or-update + toast summary
description: Companion .fmscfg import (in-app QR and file) add-or-updates matching SFTP resources by host+virtualPath instead of duplicating on re-import, and shows a toast summary of added/updated counts, naming the single affected resource.

name: Stream region-locked badge
description: In the Streams list, a channel the curated catalog flagged as region-restricted (it returned HTTP 403/451 during catalog liveness checks) shows a globe region-locked badge. The channel is kept in the catalog because it may still play in its home region; the badge signals it might not play from the user's location.

name: Fullscreen exit button for video
description: Video fullscreen now shows an always-visible exit button that returns to the command panel (main and standalone players).

name: Expanded edge-gesture action catalog with grouped picker
description: Edge gestures offer a wide action set - flashlight, screen brightness, volume, media transport, launch apps/assistant/Gemini/URL, alarm/timer/calendar, plus accessibility system actions on noLegal - chosen from a grouped picker with a short explanation for each option.

name: Viewed stream frame becomes the channel thumbnail
description: When a fullscreen VIDEO or RTSP stream renders a usable frame, the app adopts it through the same validated in-memory and persistent thumbnail pipeline as grid capture, then repaints the matching grid tile after Back and restores the frame on restart.

name: Stream preview disk cache size budget
description: Stream channel previews no longer vanish for large imported catalogs: the on-disk thumbnail cache is now bounded by a 150 MB total-size budget instead of a fixed 64-file count.

name: Quick launch tile icon legibility on light theme
description: Quick launch panel monochrome destination icons (Calculator, Mini-game, Streams, Settings and other built-in shortcuts) are now legible on the light theme - tinted to a theme on-surface color - while colored app icons and colored resource badges keep their own colors.

name: Adaptive stream quality with per-channel memory and probe-up
description: Internet video streams drop to a lower-quality rendition when playback stalls repeatedly inside a two-minute window, cutting stutter on weak connections or slow devices. Isolated stalls further apart no longer accumulate, so picture quality no longer creeps down to the lowest rendition over a long viewing session. What a channel learned now outlives the session: reopening it starts on the rung it settled on last time instead of paying the same stalls again, and the record survives a catalog re-import because it is filed by channel address rather than by row id. There is also a way back up - the player periodically retries the rung above the ceiling by really switching to it, keeps the gain only when the picture actually reaches that rung and survives a full observation window, and backs off towards hourly for a rung this line repeatedly cannot carry. Records age out after a week and the store is capped by channel count. Single-quality streams are detected and left unchanged, and RTSP is unaffected.

name: Stream-aware playback controls
description: Playback-control dialog now shows only controls the current source can honour: HUE and brightness are hidden for internet streams, speed is hidden for live streams; local files and VOD keep every control.

name: Readable VR input labels in the keybindings screen
description: VR input triggers in the Controls & Keybindings screen now show readable labels (named VR gestures like Swipe Left / Double Pinch, or a clean 'VR N' for unnamed codes) instead of the raw 'VR[15]' form; the VR-only keybinding section is hidden on builds without a VR runtime.

name: Empty channel picker routes to Streams settings
description: Adding a Channel desktop cell with no channels configured now opens Settings>Media>Streams instead of an empty picker.

name: Default desktop seeded with ~12-15 shortcuts
description: Launcher default desktop now seeds ~12-15 useful shortcuts on first run and labels the OS-settings cell Android settings.

name: Labeled scrollable app grid in Start menu
description: Launcher Start-menu All-apps list now shows installed apps as labeled icon cells in a scrollable grid instead of an unlabeled row.

name: Taller multi-column app picker
description: Launcher app picker now uses a taller sheet, adaptive multi-column grid (>=2 in portrait) and an opaque readable surface.

name: Resize home-screen gadgets
description: Resize home-screen launcher gadgets by dragging a handle in edit mode, from seed size up to full screen; size persists.

name: Functional large clock gadget
description: Launcher clock is now large with seconds, seeds bigger (4x2, resizable to 2x1), tap opens alarms and long-press opens the calendar.

name: Cell actions: launch panel + scheduled operations
description: Launcher cells can open the quick-access panel and trigger a saved scheduled operation (confirm then background run). Third-party app-shortcuts deferred to S0427.

name: Duplicate-URL guard on manual stream add
description: Manual stream add now rejects a duplicate URL with a clear message instead of crashing

name: Pinned/main split collapsible sections
description: Streams screen splits into a pinned section (shown when >=1 channel pinned) above the main section, each independently scrollable with a collapsible header, sharing one filter/order/display mode, with a single active playback.

name: Manual stream edit - type override persists on reopen
description: Fixed: an explicit stream type (Audio/Video) chosen in the manual-channel edit dialog now persists and is preselected when the dialog is reopened, instead of collapsing back to Auto.

name: Audio-stream now-playing metadata
description: Live now-playing artist and title from an audio stream, shown in the notification, on the lock screen, in the inline control and on the active grid tile.

name: Channel preview atlas
description: Video channels show a preview from a downloadable channel-preview atlas in grid mode before the first watch, replaced by the users own captured frame.

name: Local folder as scheduled-op sender/receiver
description: Assign an ad-hoc local folder as a scheduled operation sender or receiver without adding it to the resource list.

name: Flicker-free stream thumbnails
description: Stream (video-broadcast) thumbnails update without flicker or redundant re-capture: unreachable channels back off instead of re-probing every ~12s, status changes repaint only the status dot, and pinned-channel chips no longer blank on rotation.

name: Filter streams by topic
description: The streams filter dialog offers a Topic row alongside Category, Language and Country, so a catalog rubric such as Webcam can be isolated in the list; the row is hidden when the catalog carries no topics, the choice combines with the other filters and is restored on the next visit.

name: Two-column collapsed settings groups in landscape
description: Settings groups lay out in two columns in landscape while collapsed; an expanded group still spans the full width.

name: Now-playing programme name for video streams
description: The video player shows the name of the programme currently on air for a live stream, taken from its broadcast metadata.

name: Desktop weather gadget
description: Weather block on the launcher desktop: current conditions for a place the user names, keyless Open-Meteo data, no location permission

name: App quick actions on the home surface
description: Long-pressing an installed app on the launcher home surface or in the Start menu app grid lists the quick actions that app publishes (manifest and dynamic shortcuts) and starts the chosen one; apps without them keep launching on a normal tap.

name: Long-press to edit desktop, with a lock
description: Superseded by S1466: the long press now opens a menu and edit mode is one of its items. The lock toggle in launcher settings still disables the gesture, and the Start-menu entry keeps working.

name: Desktop wallpaper
description: The launcher desktop can show the branded waves-and-particles animation (default), a flat empty surface, or a picture of your own including animated GIF, copied into the app and cropped to fill the screen.

name: Device-matched lenses, zoom range and photo sizes
description: Camera now offers every physical lens the device has, its true zoom floor including sub-1x, a working macro mode and the sensor full resolution

name: Camera hardware report in System info
description: System info lists every camera the device declares, its physical sub-lenses, zoom ranges, closest focus and photo sizes, so a camera problem can be diagnosed from the phone itself

name: Radio station resumes on next launch
description: A radio station that was playing when the app was closed starts again on the next launch; video channels and an idle streams screen leave nothing to resume.

name: Every stream tile shows artwork
description: A stream tile in grid mode always shows something: its captured frame, an atlas preview, its site icon centred at a readable size, or the media-kind glyph when the channel has none.

name: Home-screen role request settles on decline
description: Choosing not to make the app your home screen is now remembered - the request is no longer repeated on later visits to Settings

name: Station logos for channels without a preview
description: Stream channels that have no capturable frame - every radio station - now show the station's own logo in grid mode instead of a small icon, via an optional downloadable logo pack

name: Downloadable extension offers its newer version
description: When an optional download (channel previews, station logos, engines) has changed since you installed it, the app now says so and offers the newer copy instead of silently keeping the old one

name: Per-channel stream track memory
description: Video streams remember the chosen audio and subtitle track per channel, with a global default audio/subtitle language for streams and a per-channel override in the channel dialog.

name: Edge bands follow the free screen edges
description: Edge gesture bands sit on the screen edges Android's own system bars leave free. They stay on the left and right in the usual layout, and move to the top and bottom when the bars occupy both side edges. Rotating the device no longer moves them by itself, the swipe directions transpose with them, and the settings diagram turns to match.

name: Device profile change confirmation names the affected setting count
description: Changing the device profile now says exactly how many settings it will overwrite instead of 'some of your settings', and a profile that overrides nothing applies without a confirmation

name: Atlas tile decode survives cache invalidation
description: Navigating away from the Streams channel grid no longer kills the app when a cached atlas is recycled mid-read

name: Best-guess stereo detection no longer claims flat films as 3D
description: Ordinary widescreen films are no longer auto-detected as side-by-side 3D when best-guess stereo detection is on

name: Immersive PREV/NEXT walk the resource
description: Immersive HUD next/previous now walk the whole resource list instead of a single file

name: Command bar icon/label vertical alignment fix
description: Command bar icons no longer sink below labels on wide low-density screens (car head units): stale probe-measure state healed after overflow width checks

name: Recording indicator visible on wide landscape layouts
description: Voice/screen recording indicator pill now actually appears (was silently dead: include-id override killed the root lookup on every layout variant, and wide-landscape layouts lacked the include entirely)

name: Built-in resource names follow language switch
description: Names and descriptions of built-in resources (Recent Media, All Music, All Files, Downloads etc.) now follow the app language when it changes, instead of staying in the first-launch language

name: Adaptive immersive HUD controls
description: Immersive VR HUD now shows only applicable controls: audio-track picker only with multiple tracks, subtitle picker only when subtitles exist, stereo depth slider only for stereo content; remaining controls spread across the freed width

name: Rename-proof secret masking in settings dump
description: Passwords and future credential fields stay masked in exported diagnostic logs even when release builds rename settings fields

name: Grouped file overflow menu
description: Browse file menu grouped into submenus (Organize, Text, Editing, Share and info) with frequent actions kept on top

name: Single stack trace per logged error
description: Session log and release logcat no longer write every error stack trace twice

name: Command row alignment for the Programs button
description: Programs button icon and label now sit on the command-row centre in both normal and compact toolbars

name: Immersive HUD hide/exit buttons and trigger summon
description: In the headset the HUD strip now has HIDE and EXIT buttons at opposite ends; hiding removes it completely and a trigger pull summons it back without pressing anything underneath

name: Immersive thumbstick seek with grip as media-step modifier
description: In the headset the thumbstick now seeks the film by 10 seconds a step; holding grip while pushing the stick steps between files instead, without dragging the panel along

name: Backgrounded copy/move stays visible on a tappable Browse strip
description: A copy or move sent to the background now stays visible in Browse on a bottom strip showing operation, percent and current file; tapping it brings the progress dialog back.

name: Fill-screen cropping is off until the user turns it on
description: Fullscreen and slideshow no longer crop an image to fill the screen by default: every device profile and the base defaults ship the option off, so pictures fit whole inside the screen until the user enables cropping in Settings.

name: Brand animation behind the welcome pages
description: The brand waves-and-particles animation now plays behind the welcome pages, with the onboarding copy on a translucent panel that keeps each page its own colour.

name: Immersive HUD seek bar
description: The immersive VR HUD now has a position bar: drag it with the controller ray to seek within a film, with elapsed and total time shown next to it

name: Deleted and moved files leave the player navigation list
description: Deleting or moving a file in the fullscreen player now takes it out of the navigation list, so going back reaches the previous file instead of an error about the file that is gone

name: Reader jump-to-start separated from the page-back arrow
description: In the PDF and EPUB readers the jump-to-start button now sits further from the page-back arrow, so a mis-tap no longer throws away your place in a long document

name: Immersive controls legend
description: On the first immersive entry after install the headset shows a legend listing every controller binding; any press closes it, and a HELP button on the HUD strip brings it back at any time

name: Long-press PDF selection without an OCR pass
description: Long-pressing a PDF page pre-selects the text under the finger straight from the page's own text layer on Android 15+, with no OCR run in between; the pressed occurrence of a repeated word is selected rather than the first one on the page

name: Immersive stereo layout read from container metadata
description: A VR video whose filename carries no layout token now has its stereo layout read from the file's own spatial metadata on immersive entry, so a properly authored 180 or 360 film no longer renders flat and mono just because its name was renamed on download

name: Live result preview while typing
description: The calculator shows the running result of a pending operation while the second number is still being typed; an operation with no answer yet, such as a divisor still reading zero, shows nothing rather than an error, which stays on the equals key

name: Wallpaper visible through shortcut cells
description: Launcher desktop shortcuts drop their card background, so the wallpaper shows through the whole grid instead of only the gaps between cells. The icon and its caption each carry a contour, keeping them readable over a bright, dark or busy picture, and the whole cell stays tappable. Gadget cells keep their surface, and edit mode restores the card look so cell boundaries stay visible while arranging.

name: System vs launcher status area
description: Choose whether the launcher keeps the Android status bar or hides it and shows its own clock, network and battery. Off by default: the system bar stays and the launcher tray drops the duplicates.

name: The app's own widgets on the launcher desktop
description: Place the same widgets the app offers for the Android home screen onto the launcher's own desktop instead. A second button in Settings opens the same picker and drops the chosen one into the first free slot, so no grid editing is needed. Each cell looks and behaves like its twin on the Android home screen: the calculator, camera, photos, reading, music, recorder, game and OCR cells open the same screens, favourites and scheduled tasks show live lists, and the now-playing cell carries working previous, play-pause and next buttons. The button appears only when launcher mode is on.

name: Contact shortcuts on the launcher desktop
description: Pin a person to the launcher home screen: a cell that opens their profile in the system contacts app, opens the dialler with their number ready to call, or opens their conversation in whichever messenger registered a channel on that contact. The app asks for no contacts permission at all - the details are read once, from the record the user picks in the system contact picker, and kept as a snapshot on the cell. Calling uses the number picker, so the pinned number is the exact one the user chose. The cell shows the person's initials over a colour that stays the same for that person.

name: Device profiles seed reader, download, player, streams and launcher defaults
description: Picking a device profile now also seeds the reader block (theme, PDF color and scroll mode, EPUB line height and margin, syntax highlighting), link-download behaviour (max resolution, audio-only, auto-download and open-in-player), player interaction (tap-zone layout, rotation follow, detailed errors), the streams start-up view (sort, media filter, catalog refresh policy, main-window panel) and, on builds that ship the home surface, the launcher desktop (grid density, taskbar contents, status-area replacement, desktop lock) - so an e-reader, a car head unit, a photo frame or an audio player starts differently from a phone instead of identically.

name: Photo profile menu on the capture screen
description: One button on the camera panel opens a menu of shooting scenarios - normal, night, portrait, selfie, macro, sport - and a single tap switches the camera into it: macro jumps straight to the dedicated close-focus lens, selfie flips to the front camera, night and portrait use the device own camera modes, sport keeps the exposure short so motion freezes. Only the scenarios the device can actually deliver are listed, the active one is named on the button, and any manual lens change returns the camera to normal. Replaces the separate macro and night buttons.

name: Swipe page turn in the PDF reader
description: Turn PDF pages by swiping: two fingers while zoomed in, one finger on an unzoomed page with no flick speed needed.

name: Folder selection, copy and move
description: Subfolders shown as list items behave like files: each row has a selection checkbox, long-press selection and the row operations menu, and copying or moving a folder recreates its whole subfolder structure at the destination - including between resources of different types (device, SMB, SFTP, FTP, cloud). Unsafe targets are refused up front with a specific reason, and folder transfers report progress and can be cancelled.

name: Left-aligned background playback bar
description: The background playback bar now groups everything at the left edge, with the stop button in the far-left corner and the bar only as wide as its content.

name: Brand backdrop with animations off
description: The animated brand backdrop now shows a still frame instead of going black after rotation when system animations are turned off

name: Edge-gesture dialog survives rotation
description: The edge-gesture configuration dialog now keeps its multi-column layout and the selected zone when the device is rotated while it is open

name: Smoothed transfer speed and rate-limited folder progress
description: Transfer speed is measured over a sliding 3 s window instead of a single buffer chunk, so the displayed rate and ETA stop swinging; folder transfers now rate-limit their progress notifications like file transfers do.

name: Active filter summary strip
description: Browse restates the active filter in words under the toolbar - name, date range, size range and media types - alongside the count badge on the filter button, matching the main screen.

name: Path button with segment menu
description: The Browse top bar shows the current location as a single fixed-width folder button instead of a breadcrumb ribbon that grew with nesting depth. Tapping it opens a menu of every path segment, and picking one jumps straight to that level. The bar keeps room for its command buttons at any depth and in any language.

name: Animated WebP/APNG still-frame thumbnail
description: Animated WebP and APNG files render a still first-frame thumbnail in the browse list, launcher folder previews, and the file-info audio cover, instead of falling back to a broken-file placeholder.

name: Backup restore respects open-in-player safety default
description: Restoring a settings backup taken before the S0981 default-off change no longer silently re-enables auto-open-in-player for downloaded link files

name: Dialog-hosted settings documented in reference
description: The published settings reference (SETTINGS_REFERENCE*.md) now documents settings hosted in dialogs (launcher, edge gestures, default apps, camera capture, camera OCR, on-screen translation), not only settings-screen rows

name: Contacts permission in permission management
description: READ_CONTACTS is registered as an optional Contacts permission group in Settings > Permissions and the onboarding permissions page, requestable on demand; denying it keeps the existing no-permission launcher pin behavior.

name: Camera settings dialog survives host recreation
description: Camera settings dialog no longer crashes when the system recreates the host Activity (theme/language/font-size change, don't keep activities, process death) - it now reconstructs its inputs from the host instead of relying on fields injected only at first show()

name: Permission rationale bottom sheet (dead code removal)
description: Removed the unreachable network-permission rationale bottom sheet and its entire dead-code chain (use cases, settings helper, launchers) - the permission it targeted already gets equivalent-or-better contextual rationale from two independent live surfaces at point of need

name: Local folder as write destination
description: Assign any local folder as the write destination for capture, screenshot, snapshot and auto-download settings, picked from the system folder browser and kept out of the general resource list

name: PDF zoom stays put when the page turns
description: The PDF reader keeps the zoom and framing you were reading at when you turn the page, by any route - arrow buttons, swipe, thumbnail sheet or go-to-page - instead of dropping every new page back to fit.

name: Share-receive copy runs in the background
description: A copy started from a received share continues after the receive screen closes, with a foreground notification while it runs and a result notification when it ends

name: Readable selected profile tile and confirm-by-repeat-tap
description: Welcome profile picker: the selected tile shows its whole description while the others stay clamped, and a repeat tap on the already-selected tile confirms the profile and advances to the next onboarding page

name: Protocol usage examples on the network sources onboarding page
description: The Welcome network sources page explains each protocol group with a plain-language usage example, and each example is hidden together with its group on builds that do not ship it

name: Default-player onboarding explains the choice and its reversibility
description: The Default Player onboarding page explains what being the default app changes and states that Android keeps the choice reversible

name: Welcome pitch states the app roles
description: The first welcome page presents the app as four roles rather than a sample of features: file manager; player of photos, video, music, GIFs, documents and text; reader of device, network and cloud sources; one-tap sorting. Each tile keeps the concrete protocol and service names (SMB, FTP, SFTP, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox) on its second line, and that line names only what the current build can actually open.

name: Dropdown settings rows can be opened and chosen with a D-pad, a keyboard or a screen reader
description: Settings dropdown rows now open a modal option list that takes window focus, so the options can be walked with D-pad or arrow keys, confirmed with Enter, and are exposed to screen readers and UI automation - previously the list was invisible to accessibility and ignored every key press

name: Now-playing bar source indication
description: The background-playback bar shows what is playing and that it is playing: a slowly turning note for a track without cover art, the channel's own icon for an audio stream that has one, and existing album art shown motionless. The rotation freezes on pause and resumes from where it stopped.

name: SD cards and mounted external drives
description: Connected removable media appear as their own section when adding a folder, each volume showing its name and free space, and a resource on one carries a removable-medium icon. Media on a card browses and sorts like built-in storage, whole folders move and copy in both directions, a copy or move that does not fit is refused before it starts with a message naming the target medium, and connecting or ejecting a medium refreshes the list without a manual rescan.

name: Interface language in thirteen languages
description: Settings opens a searchable list of thirteen interface languages. On a build installed from Play the chosen language is fetched on demand before it is applied, and a failed download leaves the app on the language it was using with the reason shown. Text that is not translated yet falls back to English.

name: Composed resource logo on launcher tiles
description: Launcher desktop and taskbar shortcuts to a resource show that resource's composed logo - its user-assigned icon, virtual-folder or cloud-provider glyph, and connection-type badge - instead of one generic icon per resource type.

name: Reset launcher settings to the as-installed state
description: Launcher settings now carry a reset icon button: after a confirmation it returns the desktop layout, taskbar pins, recents, launcher settings and wallpaper to the state they had right after installation, leaving resources, favourites and general settings untouched.

name: A launcher desktop that stays usable past the bottom of the screen
description: The launcher desktop keeps a scrollbar visible down its right edge whenever the shortcuts run past the bottom of the screen, instead of a thin overlay that fades a second after the gesture. In edit mode the taskbar carries a plus button next to Done: it opens the same content chooser an empty square opens, but drops the result into the first free position - or into a new row below everything - so a shortcut can be added even when no empty square is left on screen. Dragging a cell to the top or bottom edge in edit mode now scrolls the desktop, faster the deeper the finger goes, so a cell can be dropped in a row that was not visible when the drag started.

name: Third-party pinned shortcuts on the launcher desktop
description: Launcher mode accepts a pinned-shortcut request from any other app and places it on the desktop

name: Translation settings reachable from the Office document menu
description: The viewer overflow menu for Office documents now carries a visible Translation settings entry, matching PDF, text, EPUB and image documents; previously the dialog opened only through an undocumented long-press on the OCR or Translate row

name: Voluntary mini-game level restart
description: Restarts the current mini-game level on demand while it is still being played, from the on-screen Restart level button, the R key or gamepad Y, at the same score penalty as being caught by an enemy.

name: Contact cells for call, SMS, card and messenger
description: Launcher desktop contact cells now cover four actions - open the contact card, call, send an SMS, or open a messenger thread - each a separate entry in the cell editor, with the number taken from the system picker or typed by hand. Call and SMS entries are hidden on a device without telephony.

name: Configurable status area on the taskbar
description: The launcher taskbar's own status area is now chosen indicator by indicator - clock, Bluetooth, SIM1 signal, SIM2 signal, network type and battery, each with its own switch in launcher settings and drawn in that order. Battery is a bare number in an outline: yellow below 30 percent, red below 15, blinking below 10. An indicator the device cannot report is absent rather than blank - a Bluetooth adapter that is off, a SIM slot with no card, or a refused phone-state permission simply leaves no icon.

name: Now Playing gadget follows any app's playback
description: The Now Playing gadget on the launcher desktop shows and controls whatever is playing in any app, not only this one, once the user turns on notification access from a button on the gadget itself behind a disclosure dialog. Without that access, and whenever no other app is playing, it keeps showing this app's own playback exactly as before.

name: Channel artwork appears at once
description: Channel previews and station logos now fill the streams grid as soon as it opens instead of trickling in one picture at a time, and scrolling back shows them instantly.

name: One permission list, one wording
description: The permissions screen shows every access this build can request, including drawing over other apps and installing an app from a file, and each one is explained in the same words wherever the app asks for it.

name: Sensor gadgets on the desktop
description: The launcher desktop can carry five sensor tiles: a compass showing heading and altitude together, current speed in km/h, a speed chart and an altitude-and-distance chart that each accumulate since their own reset button was last pressed and survive a restart, and a step counter read from the system counter. The step counter is offered only in the sideload build, which is the only one declaring the activity-recognition permission the tile needs; the other four tiles are offered wherever the launcher exists. A tile whose sensor the device lacks is never offered in the picker, and a tile whose permission was refused stays on the desktop showing why it is idle. Position and step data are read only while the tile is on screen - never in the background - and nothing is transmitted.

name: Two-way content rotation
description: Rotates the displayed image or video frame in either direction from the viewer menu, clockwise or counter-clockwise, with the angle normalized so repeated turns cycle cleanly. Session-only - the file bytes and the screen sensor are untouched.

name: Editing commands in the separate player window
description: The separate player window groups its editing commands under one Editing section and gains crop in place, rename and the screen-autorotate toggle, which previously existed only as command-bar buttons or not at all.

name: Static striped wallpaper
description: The launcher can show a motionless settled frame of the branded waves-and-particles background. A new randomized frame is drawn when the launcher returns to the foreground, so the wallpaper stays still while in use.

name: Full-screen list of all installed apps
description: Launcher mode gets a full-screen list of every installed app, opened by an icon button next to Start or by swiping up on free desktop space while the desktop sits at the top. The list is served from a cache that keeps itself current through install, update and removal events, so it opens without a wait even on the first visit after a reboot. Typing narrows it as you type, matching the app name or its package name, and the order switches between name, install date, update date, how often you open it and category, with a reverse-direction entry; the chosen order is remembered between visits. A long press opens one menu carrying Open, Put on desktop, Pin to taskbar, App info and Uninstall together with the app's own published shortcuts, and an entry that cannot work on this device is left out rather than shown greyed. The old All apps row inside the Start menu is gone with its expanding grid.

name: Stream and audio diagnostics in the shared debug log
description: The debug log a user exports and sends now carries the stream and audio diagnostic lines (session summary, renditions, quality step-down, decoder, state transitions), which release builds previously dropped because the file log keeps only WARN and above. The lines keep their own level and are still secret-masked.

name: Stream grid stays quiet with no network
description: With no connectivity the stream grid no longer sweeps every visible tile into a full capture timeout, and the catalog import stops before the download instead of failing on DNS. Channels are no longer charged a cooldown for an outage, so previews return on the next sweep once the network is back, without a manual refresh.

name: Channel rubrics, grouped and translated
description: The stream catalog labels every channel with one of 31 rubrics instead of 437 free-text topics, and rubric names appear in the interface language. Sorting by rubric follows the alphabet of the language on screen.

name: Community radio and world webcams in the channel catalog
description: The downloadable channel catalog now carries private community radio stations and public webcams from keyless open directories: laut.fm, the Xiph Icecast directory, WebRadioDB, Radio Paradise, iptv-org weather and nature cams, AKC live cams, and Transport for London traffic cameras, the last marked as short clips rather than live streams.

name: Channel pictures update without waiting for an app release
description: Rebuilt channel previews and station logos now reach installed copies as soon as they are published, the same way the channel list does. The app is offered them right after a catalog refresh, with the download size stated up front.

name: Create a resource straight from the home screen
description: A new resource can be started without leaving the launcher: pick Create resource in the launcher menu, or Create new.. on the resource step of the content picker. Both open the app's ordinary resource-creation screen, and once creation succeeds the resource's shortcut is placed on the desktop by itself. Cancelling leaves nothing behind, and on a home screen that refuses pinned shortcuts the resource is still created and the app says so.

name: Full action menu on a home-screen cell
description: A long press on a resource or channel tile on the home screen now opens the same action menu the main window offers for that item - open, play, add a shortcut, edit, copy, export, share access, rescan, delete for a resource; pin, shortcut, share link and remove for a channel. The list is built from one shared definition per item kind, so the home screen and the main window can no longer drift apart, and destructive actions still ask for the same confirmation.

name: Cutout-safe launcher status signals
description: When the launcher replaces the system status area, its tappable signal row keeps every chip outside the display cutout, collapses excess signals into a +N list, and shows foreign notification application glyphs without adaptive-icon plates.

name: Launcher settings dialog grouped into collapsible sections
description: The system launcher settings dialog now presents its fourteen rows as four collapsible groups - Taskbar, Top bar, Desktop and System - and remembers which groups were left expanded.

name: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth tiles switch the radio
description: Tapping the Wi-Fi or Bluetooth tile on the launcher desktop or in the app-launch panel switches the radio itself; the system screen opens only when the platform refuses the switch. The tile icon shows the current state and follows a change made outside the app.

name: One-tap audio/video filter and a single command menu on the Streams screen
description: Two small icons beside the Streams search field split radio from video in one tap - tap the audio or video glyph to keep only that kind, tap the lit one again to show everything - and the filter agrees with the filter dialog because both read the same state. Adding a stream, updating the FastMediaSorter catalog and importing from a URL now live in one three-dot menu at the end of the command row, each running straight away instead of through an extra chooser, and the command buttons carry text labels in landscape.

name: About this channel
description: A window on any channel showing what the list stores about it and what its transmission actually carries - codecs, picture size, frame rate, bitrates and the incoming data rate, measured when the window opens. Reached from the channel card menu in list and grid, and from the video player's menu while a stream plays. A channel already playing is read off the running player rather than opened a second time, and the whole readout copies to the clipboard as text.

name: Collapsed panel chips climb into the command bar
description: In wide layout the chips left behind by the collapsed resource-type filter, programs panel and streams panel move into the free space after the last command in the top command bar, and the separate row they used to occupy disappears; a chip that does not fit stays in that row, and a full command bar keeps every chip there.

name: Technical status gadgets on the desktop
description: Four device-status cells the launcher desktop can hold: the network with its connection type, the Wi-Fi or carrier name where the system will give it without a permission, and whether the internet is reachable; the battery charge with an estimate of how long it will last, marked as approximate because Android reports no time-to-empty of its own; free and total space on internal storage and on a memory card, with the card line absent when no card is mounted; and free memory with the time since the device last booted. All four share one look, refresh only while their cell is on screen and stop the moment it leaves, read a value the device refuses to give as Unknown rather than as zero, ask for no permission, and speak both the number and its meaning to TalkBack.

name: App logo in the status bar for every notification
